sonoff-pir3-rf-motion-sensor-smart-motio.shortDescription: The SONOFF PIR3-RF is a smart motion sensor that allows you to develop a safe and comfortable home environment by detecting motion and automatically operating various devices and services.
sonoff-pir3-rf-motion-sensor-smart-motio.description:
Small 433MHz RF PIR3 Motion Sensor

SONOFF PIR3-RF

The SONOFF PIR3-RF is a smart motion sensor that allows you to create a safe and comfortable home environment by detecting motion and automatically activating various devices and services. This sensor uses PIR (Passive Infrared) technology to detect temperature changes caused by the movement of people or animals within its detection range, and sends RF signals (433MHz) to the SONOFF RF Bridge for integration with the rest of your smart device system.

Key Features

  1. Flexible and easy installation
    The sensor is characterized by its small size and simple design, which makes it easy to install anywhere inside the house, such as entrances, hallways, or different rooms.

  2. Low power consumption
    The PIR3-RF is typically powered by small dry batteries (such as AAA batteries), which means it can operate for a long time without the need to replace the batteries frequently.

  3. Seamless integration with SONOFF RF Bridge
    When connected to SONOFF RF Bridge, the sensor becomes able to communicate with the smart home network; where you can link it with other devices (such as smart lighting or security devices) and create various automation scenarios.

  4. Wide detection range
    The PIR3-RF has a suitable detection angle and effective detection range, allowing it to cover good areas inside a room or corridor, to alert you to any movement or to automatically activate certain devices.

  5. Wide applications

    • Security: Alerts you via notifications or activates an alarm when unexpected movement is detected.
    • Convenience: The lights automatically turn on when you enter the room and turn off when you leave to save energy.
    • إدارة الطاقة: دمج المستشعر مع مكيفات الهواء أو السخانات الذكية لتعمل عند وجود أشخاص في المكان فقط.

How to work with SONOFF RF Bridge

  1. Connecting the sensor to the bridge: Once the sensor is put into pairing mode, the RF bridge searches for its signals and connects it to the smart home network.

  2. Creating scenarios
    Using the eWeLink app or any supported app, you can create smart scenes; for example:

    • Activate smart lights when motion is detected at night.
    • Send an immediate alert to your phone when movement is detected while you are away.

  3. Enhanced comfort and security
    This integration between the sensor and the RF Bridge gives you the ability to customize home settings according to your different needs and times, providing a smart and safe experience.

Tips for optimal use

  • The right place: It is preferable to install the sensor at a suitable height (about 2-2.5 meters) and at an angle that covers the required area well.
  • Avoid obstructions: Make sure there are no large obstructions that impede the field of view or signal between the sensor and the RF Bridge.
  • App updates: Make sure to update the eWeLink app or supporting app regularly to take advantage of the latest features and performance improvements.
  • Battery change: Pay attention to the battery indicator in the app or monitor the sensor’s performance regularly to change the battery when needed.

In short, the SONOFF PIR3-RF is the ideal solution for anyone looking to enhance their smart home experience. Whether you’re concerned with saving energy or increasing security, you can rely on this sensor to create a sophisticated and flexible home environment that adapts to your daily needs and gives you peace of mind.

One Trigger, Endless Possibilities

PIR3-RF can be used to trigger smart devices with various protocols as long as it connects with SONOFF RF Bridge.

Alert Mode, Be Alert to Any Abnormal Movement

PIR3-RF’s unique alert mode can be triggered once every 5s which makes you more at ease when you go out, without missing any suspicious moment.

IFTTT function is only open to eWeLink VIP members

Wave Your Hand, Start A Smart Life

Simply wave to PIR3-RF and you will immediately enter the wonderful time of reading.

*The reading time is a customized scene that is when you wave to PIR3-RF, the bed-room light turns off automatically, and the table lamp turns on meanwhile the music starts playing.

sonoff-ihost-smart-home-hub-aibridge-loc.shortDescription: SONOFF offers the iHost Smart Home Hub AIBridge (model: AlBridge), an integrated local control center for your smart home system, designed to bring faster, more reliable, and safer automation to your home.
sonoff-ihost-smart-home-hub-aibridge-loc.description:
The SONOFF iHost Smart Home Hub AIBridge offers a complete solution for local control of smart home devices. It acts as a dedicated local server, allowing you to manage and control devices and connect smart scenes according to various security settings, while maintaining the privacy of your data and not sharing it with any external cloud.

Technical specifications

  • Processor and server: A dedicated local server with 4GB of capacity.
  • Contact:
    • Wired: Supports RJ45 (LAN) network interface.
    • Wireless: Compatible with Wi-Fi (IEEE b/g/n GHz) devices and standard Zigbee protocol.
  • External storage: USB or TF card can be connected (up to 256GB).
  • Power interface: 5V–2A power input via USB Type-C port.
  • Packaging: A white ABS material casing.

Features and Benefits

  • Local and secure control:

    • It allows you to manage devices and connect smart scenes over the local network without needing a constant internet connection.
    • All data (viewing, playback and security logs) is stored in a local database that supports up to 2000 records, enhancing the privacy of your information.

  • Wide connectivity and compatibility:

    • It supports connecting and operating LAN devices even in Sleep Mode, with the ability to manage up to 128 sub-devices.
    • It works with Zigbee devices and improves their performance thanks to the ESP32MG21 chip, and also supports SONOFF Zigbee devices (such as smart switches, plugs, sensors, curtain motors) to create a comprehensive ecosystem.

  • Application expansion and integration:

    • Open API and Docker container support allow you to install and develop add-ons to extend system functionality to suit your needs.
    • Seamless integration with third-party platforms such as Alexa, Google Home and Apple via Matter Bridge (under development and launching in early 2024).

  • Advanced and centralized management:

    • It provides a central control unit via a web browser for managing devices, adjusting smart scenes, configuring dashboards, and installing plugins.
    • Additional support for the eWeLink CAST application to configure a custom dashboard and manage devices collectively.

  • Outstanding network performance:

    • Display the status of all Zigbee devices on an interactive map to facilitate network management and optimization.
    • ONVIF and RTSP cameras support real-time viewing via the central control unit.

  • Smart and local automation:

    • The ability to set up local security modes and smart scenes without the need for external cloud support, ensuring continuity of operation even in the event of a connection interruption.
    • Expanding automation capabilities using Node-RED plugins to create complex scenarios and integrate with third-party applications.

Package contents

  • iHost Smart Home Hub AIBridge x 1
  • Network cable (1 meter) x 1
  • USB Type-C cable (1 meter) x 1
  • Reset pin x 1
  • Quick-use guide x 1

The SONOFF iHost Smart Home Hub AIBridge is the ideal solution for a fully integrated smart home, combining fast and secure local control, broad device compatibility, and expandable functionality through multiple add-ons and apps. Take a step towards a sophisticated smart home that protects your data privacy and provides a unique and innovative user experience.

The Tuya WiFi Smart Gas Leak Detector with Temperature Sensor is a smart safety device that combines flammable gas leak detection with ambient temperature monitoring in one practical unit. It is designed to detect natural gas (CH4) and LPG leaks while also monitoring temperature through a built-in heat sensor for improved protection. SONOFF NSPanel Pro 120 – A complete smart home control center with a touchscreen, Zigbee Hub, and Matter support.
Control all your SONOFF devices, monitor your cameras, manage energy consumption, and benefit from an advanced security system. Ideal for unifying and managing all your smart home systems from one place.
sonoff-nspanel-pro-smart-home-monitor.description:
In the rapidly evolving world of smart homes, SONOFF presents the flagship NSPanel Pro 120 control panel, designed to be the heart of any smart home system. It combines a high-quality touchscreen, Zigbee 3.0 Hub, Matter support, a built-in security system, and advanced energy monitoring capabilities – all in one sleek and customizable interface.

💡 Integrated design and functionality

NSPanel Pro 120 is designed as a central hub that controls all your smart home devices from a single location. Thanks to its interactive interface, users can add visual controls (widgets) for all supported SONOFF devices, with the ability to control them directly or via smart scenes.

🔗 Built-in Zigbee 3.0 gateway – fast and stable connection

The board supports the Zigbee 3.0 protocol, allowing for the quick and efficient addition of dozens of smart devices, such as:

  • Motion and door/window sensors

  • Irrigation valves

  • Smart plugs
    These devices can be voice-controlled via Amazon Alexa and Google Home, or managed through the eWeLink app.

🧱 Matter Support – Multi-device compatibility

As a Matter Hub/Controller, the NSPanel Pro 120 allows users to add smart devices from different companies to the eWeLink app, including Matter-compatible switches, sockets, and sensors, making it an ideal solution for unifying multi-brand smart homes.

🔒 Advanced Home Security System

The board is equipped with professional security features:

  • 3 customizable protection modes (Home / Away / Sleep)

  • When any movement is detected via the connected sensors, the panel emits an audible alarm and sends a direct notification to the phone.

  • It can be relied upon as a primary alarm system for homes and offices.

📹 Support for live camera feeds

The panel transforms into a smart monitoring screen by supporting the display of 4 types of cameras in real time.
You can use the panel to monitor:

  • House entrance

  • living room

  • The garage

  • Children’s Room
    The panel also supports two-way communication (Intercom) using the built-in microphone and speaker, making it ideal for answering visitors or communicating between rooms.

⚡ Energy consumption monitoring

NSPanel Pro can track daily energy consumption across compatible devices.
Features include:

  • Display energy consumption for each device

  • Weekly analysis via charts

  • Support for exporting data for professional use
    All of this contributes to improved efficiency and reduced billing.

🎨 Fully customizable interface

The main interface screen can be easily customized by changing backgrounds, arranging widgets, and adjusting the layout to the user’s liking, giving you a unique and comfortable user experience.

🔧 Advanced integration and future expansions

NSPanel Pro supports advanced features for developers and advanced users such as:

  • Node-RED

  • Homebridge

  • Open API

  • Partial Sync Add-ons
    It is constantly evolving with software updates that add more features such as weather clock, PIN code, guest mode, reminders, and more.

🎯 Ideal uses:

  • Complete control of smart home devices from a single screen

  • Building an integrated protection and alert system

  • Energy management and electricity consumption monitoring

  • Monitoring cameras and responding to visitors

  • Unify home appliances from different brands through Matter

Sonoff NSpanel 120 PRO

🛒 SONOFF NSPanel Pro 120 – The smart center for your home

One panel, unlimited control.
Elevate your smart home experience with a device that offers you security, convenience, and ultimate flexibility.
NSPanel Pro 120 is more than just a controller… it’s a complete smart system in your hands.

sonoff-snzb-02d-smart-temperature-and-hu.description:
The SONOFF SNZB-02D sensor provides an accurate and efficient solution for monitoring temperature and humidity throughout your home or office. It features a clear and easy-to-read 2.5-inch LCD display and utilizes the Zigbee 3.0 protocol for reliable connectivity and seamless integration with smart home systems.

Key Features

Clear LCD Display
A large 2.5-inch screen clearly displays temperature and humidity. It includes smart icons for weather conditions such as dryness, high humidity, or heat, to help you make informed environmental decisions.

High accuracy and fast update
The sensor is based on a precise Swiss unit of measurement with a range of ±0.2°C for temperature and ±2% for humidity, with an update every 5 seconds to ensure accurate and real-time readings.

Smart integration with the Zigbee ecosystem
Supports all popular Zigbee 3.0 gateways such as SONOFF ZBBridge-P, NSPanel Pro, and ZBDongle-E/P. It also supports integration with Alexa Zigbee Hub and can be connected to the Home Assistant platform via ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT.

Instant alerts and smart control
The sensor can be set up as a smart trigger to turn devices like a humidifier or air conditioner on or off when certain temperature or humidity levels are reached. The user receives instant notifications on their phone when the set values ​​are exceeded.

Historical data logging and analysis
The app supports free cloud storage for up to 6 months of data. Recorded values ​​can be viewed hourly, daily, or weekly, with the option to export data in CSV format.

Multiple mounting options
The sensor includes three mounting methods: magnetic mounting, 3M adhesive backing, or placement on flat surfaces, making it suitable for multiple locations such as the living room, children’s room, basement, or agricultural incubators.

Turn any traditional 433.92MHz device into a smart device that can be remotely controlled via the eWeLink app, thanks to the SONOFF RF Bridge R2 – the wireless gateway that connects the world of radio frequency (RF) and modern Wi-Fi technologies.

  • Smart alert on mobile phone:
    When the sensor is activated, an instant notification is sent to your smartphone via the eWeLink app.

  • Voice control support:
    You can control the valve via voice commands through Amazon Alexa or Google Home.

  • Quick and easy installation:
    No need for any plumbing work or complicated connections – just place the sensor in the right place and it will start working immediately.

  • Reopening manually or via the app: After the valve closes automatically, it can be reopened manually or via the eWeLink app on the phone.

⚠️ Important note:

  • The sensor does not work with SONOFF RF Bridge or conventional RF devices, but only communicates with the eWeLink smart water valve that supports automatic shut-off via Wi-Fi.

zemismart-m6-matter-zigbee-hub.description:
Zemismart Matter Zigbee Thread Smart Home Hub – Multi-Protocol Matter Bridge

The Zemismart M1 Matter Hub is a multi-protocol smart home bridge designed
to bring your Tuya ZigBee and Thread devices into a unified
Matter-certified ecosystem. With one compact hub, you can connect lights,
switches, curtain motors, sensors and more, and control them from
Tuya / Smart Life, Google Home and Apple HomeKit.

Key Features

  • Support Multi-Protocol: works with Tuya ZigBee standard devices and Thread devices, and exposes them to a Matter system (Matter border router required).
  • Multi-platform usage: allows Tuya ZigBee devices to be used on third-party platforms like Google Home and HomeKit via Matter.
  • APP Remote Control: control all your connected devices anytime, anywhere with Tuya App / Smart Life App / Google Home / HomeKit.
  • Voice Control: once Thread/ZigBee devices are added to the hub, you can control them via Siri and Google Assistant.
  • Multi sub-device control: connect various sub-devices (lights, switches, roller motors, curtain tracks, sensors, etc.) and create powerful smart scenes.
  • Wired network connection: built-in RJ45 Ethernet port for a more stable and efficient connection to the internet.
  • High-quality craftsmanship: flame-retardant plastic housing and clean internal layout ensure long-term reliable operation.

What Can the M1 Hub Control?

  • ZigBee devices: ceiling lamps, downlights, EU/US wall switches, roller motors, curtain drivers, PIR motion sensors, door/window sensors, temperature & humidity sensors and more.
  • Thread devices: Thread curtain motors, Thread roller shade motors, Thread switches and other Thread-based accessories.
  • Through Matter, these devices can be visible and controllable in both Google Home and Apple Home apps.

Technical Overview

Protocols Tuya ZigBee Standard, Thread, Matter (via Matter border router)
Smart Platforms Tuya App, Smart Life App, Google Home, Apple HomeKit
Voice Assistants Siri, Google Assistant (after linking through Matter)
Internet Connection RJ45 Ethernet (internet cable required)
Housing Material Flame-retardant plastic
Main Function Matter bridge for ZigBee/Thread sub-devices, scene automation and multi-platform control
Use Cases Lighting, curtain and blind motors, wall switches, motion/contact sensors, temperature and humidity sensors, etc.

Ideal For

  • Users who already have Tuya ZigBee devices and want to control them with Google Home and Apple HomeKit.
  • New smart home installations that want a Matter-ready backbone using ZigBee and Thread.
  • Projects that require stable Ethernet-based hub connectivity instead of Wi-Fi only.

tuya-app-wifi-door-exit-button-smart.shortDescription: The Tuya App WiFi Door Exit Button is a smart wireless door-opening switch designed for modern electronic lock and access control systems. It combines Wi-Fi connectivity with RF433 remote control, allowing you to release doors locally with a push and remotely from your smartphone via the Tuya / Smart Life app.
tuya-app-wifi-door-exit-button-smart.description:
زر خروج باب ذكي WiFi من Tuya – تحكم عن بعد وصوتي لفتح الأقفال الإلكترونية

حوّل نظام الدخول والخروج في مكتبك أو شقتك إلى نظام ذكي بالكامل مع
Tuya App WiFi Door Exit Button.
زر خروج لاسلكي يعمل عبر شبكة Wi-Fi ويدعم RF433 للتحكم عن بُعد في
الأقفال الإلكترونية ضمن أنظمة التحكم في الأبواب، مع إمكانية الفتح من
الموبايل أو عن طريق الأوامر الصوتية المدعومة من منصة Tuya.

أهم المميزات

  • زر خروج ذكي عبر Wi-Fi: مصمم لأنظمة التحكم في الأبواب الإلكترونية في المكاتب، الشقق، الفنادق والمحلات.
  • تحكم من تطبيق Tuya / Smart Life: فتح الباب أو تحرير القفل بضغطة من الموبايل من أي مكان يتوفر فيه إنترنت.
  • دعم RF433: يمكن إقرانه مع ريموت RF433 للتحكم اللاسلكي في مدى قريب بدون فتح التطبيق.
  • مزامنة فورية للحالة: حالة الزر والقفل تظهر لحظيًا في التطبيق (تشغيل / إيقاف / فتح).
  • مشاركة ذكية: يمكن مشاركة الجهاز مع عدة مستخدمين – موبايل رئيسي بصلاحية كاملة وموبايلات إضافية بصلاحيات محددة.
  • يدعم الأوامر الصوتية: يمكن ربطه بالمساعدات الصوتية المدعومة من Tuya لفتح الباب بالصوت (حسب إعدادات المنظومة).

ملاحظات التثبيت والتشغيل

  • يجب توفير مزود طاقة منظم 12V DC للزر حتى يعمل التحكم عن بُعد من الموبايل.
  • يُركّب في نظام التيار الضعيف (Weak Current) بعيدًا عن دوائر الجهد العالي.
  • يجب أن يكون مكان التركيب داخل تغطية شبكة Wi-Fi.
  • يُنصح بتجنب وجود مصادر تداخل مغناطيسي قوي أو كابلات طاقة عالية الجهد بالقرب من الزر.

أنماط التحكم

  • زر الضغط المباشر: خروج العاملين أو الزوار بالضغط المباشر على زر الباب.
  • ريموت RF433: فتح الباب عن بعد داخل المكتب أو الاستقبال باستخدام ريموت لاسلكي.
  • تحكم من التطبيق: فتح الباب أو تحرير القفل عبر تطبيق Tuya / Smart Life من أي مكان.
  • مشاركة سحابية: موبايل واحد يكون الحساب الرئيسي، ويمكنه إدارة المستخدمين المشتركين على نفس الجهاز.

نوع النظام نظام تحكم في الدخول / Access Control – تيار ضعيف
الاتصال اللاسلكي Wi-Fi (يتطلب تغطية شبكة) + RF433 للتحكم عن بعد
التطبيق المدعوم Tuya App / Smart Life – تحكم سحابي ومشاركة مستخدمين
التغذية الكهربائية مزود طاقة منظم 12V DC (غير مرفق)
التركيب على الحائط بجوار الباب/البوابة، داخل نظام Low Voltage
الاستخدام أبواب مكاتب – شقق – غرف فنادق – بوابات دخول داخلية

aqara-a100-smart-lock.shortDescription: Aqara A100 Zigbee Smart Lock delivers convenient, secure access with fingerprint recognition, PIN codes, NFC and emergency keys. Enjoy flexible user management, Apple Home integration and smart connectivity for a more convenient everyday entry experience.
aqara-a100-smart-lock.description:
Aqara A100 Smart Lock –
Zigbee Fingerprint Door Lock

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
combines convenient keyless entry,
advanced access management,
and connected-home functionality
in a modern door lock designed
for residential use.
The A100 Zigbee model,
ZNMS02ES, offers multiple
unlocking methods including
fingerprint recognition,
PIN codes, supported NFC credentials,
and mechanical emergency keys.

Designed for homes and apartments,
this smart door lock gives
family members flexible ways
to access their property
without relying exclusively
on traditional keys.
It can also integrate with
supported Aqara and Apple Home
configurations to become part
of a connected household.

The lock operates using
eight AA batteries and includes
a USB-C emergency power input.
Compatible smart home features,
remote functions, and automations
may require an additional hub,
supported controller,
or suitable account configuration.

Zigbee
Fingerprint Unlock
PIN Codes
NFC
Apple Home
Bluetooth 5.0
USB-C Emergency Power

Fingerprint Unlocking for Daily Access

Unlock your door with a registered
fingerprint for a practical
and convenient everyday experience.
Fingerprint recognition is useful
for household members who prefer
quick access without entering
a password or carrying a key.

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
supports multiple authorized users,
allowing compatible access
credentials to be organized
according to household needs.

Flexible PIN Code Entry

The integrated numeric keypad
provides an alternative way
to open the door.
PIN access is particularly
useful when fingerprint
unlocking is not preferred
or suitable for a specific user.

Supported temporary and scheduled
password functions can provide
additional flexibility for
authorized visitors, depending
on the configured system
and available features.

NFC Access and Emergency Keys

Compatible NFC credentials
provide an additional
unlocking method alongside
fingerprint and PIN entry.
This allows different
household members to choose
an access method that suits
their preferences.

Mechanical emergency keys
provide a physical access
alternative when required.
Keep emergency keys
in a safe location outside
the locked property.

Zigbee Connectivity for Smart Homes

Zigbee connectivity enables
supported integration with
compatible Aqara smart home
equipment and connected
home configurations.

With a suitable hub,
certain monitoring features,
automation options,
and connected functions
may become available.
Actual capabilities depend
on the hub model,
software version,
and supported services.

Key Features of the Aqara A100 Smart Lock

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
provides several access
and connectivity features
for everyday home security
and convenient entry.

  • Fingerprint recognition
    for registered users.
  • PIN code entry through
    the integrated keypad.
  • Support for compatible
    NFC access credentials.
  • Mechanical emergency key access.
  • Zigbee connectivity for supported
    smart home integrations.
  • Apple Home compatibility,
    subject to setup requirements.
  • User management and supported
    temporary access options.
  • Eight AA batteries with
    USB-C emergency power input.

Apple Home and Aqara Smart Home Integration

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
supports compatible Apple Home
and Aqara ecosystem configurations,
allowing it to participate
in supported connected-home
experiences.

Depending on the configuration,
the lock may work alongside
compatible smart lighting,
sensors, and automation devices
to support convenient
household routines.

Some connected features
require a suitable Aqara hub
or compatible controller.
Remote access and automation
capabilities should be checked
against the exact hardware,
software, and regional setup.

Before purchasing,
confirm the functions required
for your smart home project
and the accessories
needed to enable them.

User Management and Access Permissions

Managing access is an important
part of a smart door lock.
Multiple authorized users
can be assigned supported
credentials, allowing
different household members
to use their preferred
unlocking methods.

Temporary and scheduled
access credentials can also
be helpful in situations
where selected visitors
need controlled entry
for a limited period.

Available credential limits
and management functions
depend on the installed
product version, firmware,
and supported application.

Security and Emergency Access

The electronic locking system
offers several methods
for authorized entry
while retaining mechanical
emergency access.

A USB-C emergency power
connection is also provided
for situations where the
installed batteries do not
have sufficient power.

The emergency USB-C input
is intended to supply
temporary external power;
it does not mean the
lock uses an internal
rechargeable battery.

Correct installation,
door alignment,
secure password management,
and regular maintenance
remain important for
safe and reliable operation.

Battery Power and Maintenance

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
operates using eight AA batteries,
with a nominal 6V power supply.
The device also includes
a 5V USB-C emergency power
input for temporary use
when required.

Battery life depends on
usage patterns,
environmental conditions,
and installed battery quality.
Follow manufacturer guidance
when replacing batteries,
and avoid mixing batteries
of different ages or types.

Check the door mechanism
periodically to ensure
that the latch and lock
operate smoothly.

Door Compatibility and Installation

Before installing the
Aqara A100 Smart Lock,
confirm that the door
meets the required
installation dimensions.

Check the door thickness,
opening direction,
existing lock body,
and available mounting space.
The A100 Zigbee uses
a full-size lock mechanism,
so it should not be treated
as a universal replacement
for every existing lock.

Professional installation
is recommended when
door preparation,
mortise replacement,
or additional drilling
is required.

Use the manufacturer’s
installation drawing
to verify all measurements
before modifying the door.

Everyday Uses for Homes and Apartments

The lock is suitable
for households seeking
greater flexibility
in daily door access.
Fingerprint recognition
provides a convenient option
for regular users,
while PIN and NFC access
offer alternatives.

For connected homes,
supported lock events
may be integrated into
compatible automation routines.
Available functions depend
on the installed hub
and connected ecosystem.

Its combination of
access methods and
user management tools
can also help families
organize credentials
for different authorized users.

The Aqara A100 Smart Lock
brings together multiple

For households looking

a flexible alternative

Important Note:

compatible smart home
equipment and account setup.
Always verify door dimensions,

with Built-In Zigbee 3.0 Smart Home Hub

sensors, switches, and other
supported devices. This allows
the camera to become part

system without requiring a
separate hub for supported functions.

The G3 also supports dual-band
Wi-Fi, infrared appliance control,

Available functions can vary
depending on platform,
software version, and
network configuration.

340 degrees of

Recognition accuracy

camera positioning,
distance, and
software settings.

Gesture Recognition for Smart Home Actions

The camera supports

This provides an additional

Beyond its camera functions,

This makes it possible

motion sensors,

Zigbee repeater devices

Aqara hub for

Smart Home Scenes and Automations

The camera and its
built-in hub can become

home automation system

Supported sensor events,
recognition functions,
and connected devices

useful automation routines.

For example, a compatible
motion or door sensor

or activate a selected

Available automation

the connected equipment,
supported software,
and selected settings.

Infrared Control for Compatible Appliances

The integrated
IR controller

compatible televisions
and air conditioners.

This feature provides

The camera supports
indoor monitoring
in low-light conditions,
allowing users to
observe supported
areas at different

Night-time image quality

available lighting,
and active camera settings.

For better results,

or strong reflections
do not interfere
with the viewing area.

The G3 includes a

lens away from its
normal viewing position.

This provides a visible
indication that the camera

not required.

The camera also supports

Users should review

according to their

Dual-Band Wi-Fi Connectivity

The device supports
both 2.4 GHz

platforms.

Before planning a

confirm compatibility
with the desired
platform and devices.

Local Recording with microSD Storage

local video storage

microSD card

Everyday Uses Around the Home

spaces such as living

to adjust the camera
direction within

a central connection
point for compatible
Aqara sensors and
smart switches,

monitoring and
home automation

avatto-relay-switch-4-channel-smart-modu.description:
Avatto Relay Switch –
4 Channel Smart Relay Module

The Avatto Relay Switch
is a four-channel smart control module
designed to manage compatible electrical
circuits and equipment independently.
It combines multiple relay outputs
with convenient app-based switching,
scheduling, and automation functions.

The AVATTO 4 Channel Relay
can be integrated into selected
lighting systems, garage door controls,
water pump control circuits,
and other compatible applications.
The exact wiring arrangement
depends on the connected equipment.

This product family includes
Wi-Fi and Zigbee versions,
as well as different power
input options.
Each version must be selected
according to the project’s
electrical and networking requirements.

Compatible configurations support
Tuya Smart and Smart Life,
allowing users to manage
relay channels from a smartphone
and create supported schedules
or smart home routines.

4 Independent Channels
Wi-Fi / Zigbee Versions
Tuya Smart
Smart Life
Voice Control
Smart Automation

Four Independent Relay Channels

The module provides four relay
channels that can be operated
independently through supported
control methods.

This makes it possible
to organize multiple
switching functions
using one controller.

Each channel can be assigned
to a compatible circuit
or equipment control input,
subject to the correct
wiring and electrical rating.

Wi-Fi or Zigbee Connectivity

Wi-Fi models can connect
through a compatible
2.4GHz wireless network.

Zigbee versions require
an appropriate Zigbee gateway
for supported smart control.

Wi-Fi and Zigbee are
different product options.
Do not assume both wireless
protocols are included
in the same physical module.

Remote Smartphone Control

The Avatto Relay Switch
supports app-based operation
through Tuya Smart or Smart Life
in compatible configurations.

Users can switch supported
outputs on or off and manage
selected automation functions.

Remote access requires
the appropriate network,
account, and gateway
where applicable.

Timers and Scheduling

Supported versions allow
users to configure timed
switching and automation
through the connected app.

For example, a compatible
lighting circuit can be
scheduled to turn on
at a selected time.

Schedules can help simplify
regular switching tasks
and everyday home management.

Key Features of the AVATTO Smart Relay Module

  • Four Relay Outputs:
    Independent management
    of four compatible channels.
  • Mobile App Control:
    Tuya Smart and Smart Life
    support on compatible versions.
  • Wi-Fi or Zigbee Options:
    Select the connectivity
    required for your smart home.
  • Voice Assistant Integration:
    Support for Alexa and
    Google Assistant where available.
  • Scheduling:
    Set timers and switching
    routines through supported apps.
  • Smart Home Automation:
    Combine relay actions
    with compatible devices.
  • Family Sharing:
    Share supported control permissions
    with household members.
  • Flexible Applications:
    Suitable for selected lighting,
    gate, pump, and switching projects.

Available Control Methods

Depending on the model,
the device may support several
ways to operate the relay outputs.

Common control methods include
the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app,
compatible voice assistants,
and local module buttons.

Certain variants also support
a 433MHz RF remote
for local wireless switching.

RF support and the inclusion
of a remote control
must be checked against
the selected model.

Family Sharing and Shared Access

Compatible Tuya and Smart Life
configurations allow supported
device access to be shared
with other household members.

This feature can make
everyday control more convenient
when several family members
need access to the same
smart home installation.

Sharing permissions depend
on the app, account settings,
and device capabilities.

Smart Home Automation and Scenes

The AVATTO Smart Relay Module
can participate in supported
home automation scenes
with other connected devices.

For example, a compatible
sensor event may trigger
a selected relay channel,
or a scheduled routine
may control several outputs.

Automation availability
depends on the installed version,
the selected app,
and the connected ecosystem.

These functions can help
upgrade traditional switching
to a more flexible
smart home control system.

Applications for Lighting and Equipment

A 4 Channel Smart Relay
may be suitable for
selected lighting circuits,
garage door controls,
gate automation inputs,
and equipment switching.

Some applications use
momentary dry-contact signals,
while others require
continuous switching.

Water pumps and motors
may require separate contactors,
protective devices,
or specialized control circuits.

Always confirm the relay’s
contact type, operating mode,
and electrical ratings
before connecting equipment.

Choosing Wi-Fi or Zigbee

A Wi-Fi module can be useful
when the installation already
has a suitable 2.4GHz network.

A Zigbee model may be preferred
in a system built around
a compatible Zigbee gateway.

The best choice depends
on the existing installation,
wireless coverage,
supported devices,
and automation requirements.

Check the exact product variant
before purchasing or pairing.

Input Voltage and Electrical Load

AVATTO four-channel
relay products are available
with different power input options.

Depending on the variant,
these may include
AC/DC 7–32V
or AC 85–250V.

Some models specify a
10A rating per channel.
However, the actual
channel ratings and total
permitted load must be confirmed
from the selected product’s
label and technical manual.

The input power specification
is not the same as the
output contact rating.

Never connect mains voltage
to an input intended only
for low-voltage operation.

Installation and Electrical Safety

The module should be installed
according to the wiring diagram
provided for its exact model.

Before installation,
confirm the supply voltage,
relay output terminals,
and permitted load type.

Disconnect electrical power
before performing wiring
or maintenance.

A qualified electrician
should carry out installation
and verify safe operation
of the connected equipment.

The module offers
a practical way to manage
four compatible switching
functions within one
smart control device.

AVATTO HE20 WiFi Human Presence Sensor with mmWave 24GHz

If you are looking for a smarter and more accurate alternative to traditional motion sensors, the AVATTO HE20 WiFi Human Presence Sensor offers a more advanced experience through 24GHz mmWave technology. It can detect real human presence even without obvious movement by recognizing micro-movements such as breathing or slight posture changes, making it ideal for smart lighting, automation, and presence-based room control.

True human presence detection

  • Powered by advanced 24GHz mmWave technology.
  • Detects people even without obvious body movement.
  • More accurate than many traditional motion sensors.
  • Ideal for bedrooms, offices, and spaces where people may remain still for long periods.

3 detection states

  • No one present
  • Presence
  • Motion

This gives users more flexibility when building smart automations based on the real room condition, not only on simple movement detection.

Wide angle and practical detection range

The sensor provides a detection range of up to 5 meters and a detection angle of 120°, making it suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, children’s rooms, and many other indoor spaces. According to the provided specifications, detection accuracy can reach ±10 cm.

Works in all lighting conditions

One of the key advantages of the AVATTO HE20 is that it works effectively in both daytime and nighttime conditions, making it suitable for continuous smart home use regardless of room lighting.

Instant alerts and event records

The sensor can send instant push notifications to your phone when motion or presence is detected, and it also supports event history logging inside the app for easier tracking and review.

Smart integration with Tuya and Smart Life

The sensor works through WiFi 2.4GHz and integrates smoothly with Tuya Smart and Smart Life, allowing you to create smart automations such as turning on the lights when entering a room, switching off devices when no one is present, or activating air conditioning and curtains based on occupancy.

Voice interaction and room status

The sensor is compatible with Amazon Alexa and Google Home, and it can be used inside smart home routines and voice-based status checks depending on the platform setup and linked automations.

Adjustable sensitivity

  • Low
  • Medium
  • High

This allows you to fine-tune the sensor performance depending on room size and the required detection style for better daily accuracy and fewer unwanted triggers.

Compact elegant design

The AVATTO HE20 features a compact and elegant round design that fits well into modern interiors. It can be mounted on the wall or ceiling depending on the desired coverage angle and installation environment.

Ideal use cases

  • Living rooms
  • Bedrooms
  • Offices
  • Children’s rooms
  • Hallways and indoor spaces
  • Automation scenes for lights, curtains, and air conditioning

Zigbee 3.0 Smart Home Control

The Aqara Hub M1S Gen 2
is a compact smart home control center
that connects compatible Aqara sensors,
switches, and connected devices
through Zigbee 3.0 technology.
It serves as a central connection point
for building a more convenient
and responsive smart home.

The hub combines
device management, automation,
security alerts, and ambient lighting
in a single unit.
Through the Aqara Home app,
users can manage supported
devices and create routines
that suit their everyday needs.

The Aqara M1S Gen 2
also includes a built-in 2W speaker,
an RGB LED light ring,
and an illumination sensor.
These features allow it to act
as more than a basic
Zigbee connection gateway.

Compatible integrations
with Apple Home, Amazon Alexa,
Google Assistant, and IFTTT
provide additional ways
to interact with supported
smart home products.
Availability varies by device,
platform, and setup.

Zigbee 3.0
Up to 128 Devices

Apple Home

Zigbee 3.0 Smart Home Connectivity

The Aqara Zigbee 3.0 Hub
connects compatible devices
through a Zigbee network,
including selected motion sensors,
door and window sensors,
smart switches, and other
supported Aqara products.

Zigbee 3.0 offers
energy-efficient communication
and responsive interaction
between connected devices,
making it suitable for
home automation systems.

Connect Up to 128 Aqara Devices

Build a larger smart home
by connecting up to
128 compatible
Aqara Zigbee child devices.

requires suitable Zigbee repeaters,

or compatible wired switches
with neutral.

Built-In 2W Speaker and Alarm

The integrated
2-watt speaker

doorbell alerts, and
other supported audio
notifications.

When connected to compatible
Aqara sensors, it can help
provide audible alerts
for selected security
and automation events.

RGB Night Light with 18 LEDs

A built-in RGB light ring
contains 18 LEDs
with configurable colors
and brightness levels.

The light can function
as a night light,
ambient accent,
or visual notification
within supported smart
home scenarios.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Zigbee 3.0 Hub:
    Connect compatible Aqara
    smart home devices.
  • Up to 128 Devices:
    Expand the network with

  • 2W Alarm Speaker:

  • 18-LED RGB Light:

Built-In Illumination Sensor

and make that information
available for supported
Aqara Home automations.

For example, compatible
lighting routines may be
configured to respond
to changes in room brightness.
The available behavior
depends on connected devices
and automation settings.

Smart Security and HomeKit Alarm Modes

The hub can form part
of an Aqara security setup
when combined with compatible
door, window, or motion sensors.

Its built-in speaker
can provide audible alerts
when supported security
conditions are triggered.

The device also supports
the four HomeKit
security system modes:
Home, Away, Night,
and Off.

These modes help users
configure suitable security
behavior according to
their household routines
and connected equipment.

Local Automation and Smart Scenes

The hub supports
compatible local automations
within the Aqara ecosystem,
helping connected devices
respond to supported events
without requiring every action
to be processed through
an external cloud service.

For example, a door sensor
may be used to activate
a supported alert,
while a motion sensor
can trigger compatible

Apple Home, Alexa and Google Integration

Enhanced 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Connectivity

aqara-motion-sensor-p1.description:
Aqara Motion Sensor P1 –
Smart Zigbee 3.0 Motion Detection

The Aqara Motion Sensor P1
helps enhance home security and automation
by detecting movement in indoor spaces.
It can be used to activate compatible
smart lighting, trigger security alerts,
and create practical automation routines
when paired with a supported hub.

This Smart Motion Sensor
uses passive infrared (PIR) technology
and Zigbee 3.0 connectivity.
Its adjustable sensitivity,
configurable detection timeout,
and wide-angle coverage allow users
to tailor motion detection
to different rooms and requirements.

An integrated light sensor
also supports automations
based on movement and
ambient brightness.
The device is designed
for low power consumption,
with battery life of up to five years
under specified operating conditions.

Zigbee 3.0
PIR Detection
Up to 5 Years
170° Coverage
Adjustable Sensitivity
Light Sensor

Up to 5-Year Battery Life

The sensor is designed for
energy-efficient operation,
reducing the need for
frequent battery replacement.

Battery life can reach
up to five years
when the LED indication
is disabled and the
detection timeout is set
to at least 30 seconds.

Actual battery life
depends on detection frequency,
selected settings,
temperature, and usage.

Customizable Detection Timeout

Users can configure the
Detection Timeout
from 1 to 200 seconds
through the Aqara Home app.

This setting controls
the interval between
supported motion detection events,
allowing the sensor to suit
different automation requirements.

Shorter detection intervals
can provide more frequent events,
but may increase
battery consumption.

Wide-Angle Motion Coverage

The sensor offers
170° coverage
at up to 2 meters
and 150° coverage
at up to 7 meters.

Its adjustable mounting holder
supports flexible positioning
to help direct detection
toward the required area.

The holder can rotate
to support a range
of indoor installation positions.

Three Adjustable Sensitivity Levels

Choose from
high, medium,
or low sensitivity
according to room size
and detection requirements.

Adjusting the sensitivity
changes the approximate
triggering distance and can help
reduce unwanted motion events.

Proper sensor positioning
is also important
for reliable operation.

Key Features of the Motion Sensor P1

  • Zigbee 3.0 Connectivity:
    Connects to a compatible Aqara hub.
  • PIR Motion Detection:
    Detects movement without recording video.
  • Long Battery Life:
    Up to five years under specified conditions.
  • Wide Detection Angle:
    Up to 170° at shorter distances.
  • Adjustable Sensitivity:
    High, medium, and low settings.
  • Customizable Timeout:
    Detection interval from 1 to 200 seconds.
  • Built-In Light Sensor:
    Supports brightness-based automations.
  • Flexible Mounting:
    Adjustable holder with adhesive installation.

Smart Security Alerts and Home Monitoring

The sensor can become part
of a connected security system
when paired with a compatible hub
and supported alarm devices.

Motion detection can trigger
mobile notifications,
supported security scenes,
or sound and light alarms
through other connected devices.

For example, a compatible
Aqara hub with a built-in speaker
can provide an audible alert
when a configured security
condition is triggered.

The motion sensor itself
does not contain a camera
or a built-in alarm siren.

Smart Home Automation and Lighting Control

The Aqara Zigbee Motion Sensor
can help automate connected lighting,
smart switches, and other supported
home devices.

Possible automation routines include
turning on hallway lights
when motion is detected
and switching them off
after a suitable period
without detected movement.

A nighttime routine can also
activate dim lighting
or a selected smart home scene
when movement is detected.

These functions require
compatible connected equipment
and appropriate automation settings.

Built-In Light Sensor for Energy Efficiency

The integrated light sensor
can be used to create
more precise lighting automations.

For example, supported lighting
can be configured to turn on
when movement is detected
only if the room is dark.

This reduces unnecessary lighting
during daylight hours
and helps create
a more convenient home environment.

Smart Home Compatibility and Zigbee 3.0

This Zigbee 3.0 Motion Sensor
requires a compatible
Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub
for connected operation.

Depending on the hub
and supported integration,
the device can participate
in smart home systems
including Aqara Home,
Apple HomeKit,
Amazon Alexa,
and IFTTT.

Feature availability may vary
between ecosystems
and according to software
and regional settings.

Matter integration,
where supported,
requires an appropriate
Matter-compatible Aqara hub.
The sensor does not operate
as a standalone Matter device.

Easy Installation and Flexible Positioning

The included holder
and adhesive sticker
make installation straightforward
in suitable indoor locations.

The mounting holder can be adjusted
to direct the detection area
toward a doorway,
hallway, or other target zone.

Avoid locations directly facing
strong heat sources,
sunlight, or other conditions
that may affect PIR detection.

The sensor is intended
for indoor use.

Everyday Smart Home Applications

In hallways, the device
can trigger compatible lighting
when someone passes through.

In bedrooms, supported routines
may activate low-brightness lighting
during selected nighttime hours.

In living areas, motion events
can be used to automate
compatible switches
or connected appliances.

The sensor may also be included
in home security scenes
for motion notifications
during selected periods.

Reliable Motion Detection and Configuration

For effective performance,
consider the room layout,
sensor sensitivity,
detection angle,
and mounting height.

Because PIR detection
responds to changes
in infrared radiation,
installation near heating
equipment or strong sunlight
may affect detection behavior.

Select the appropriate timeout
and sensitivity according
to the required automation
and normal room activity.

aqara-water-leak-sensor.shortDescription: Aqara Water Leak Sensor detects water leaks near sinks, washing machines, and water heaters. This Zigbee Water Leak Sensor features IP67 dust and water resistance, a CR2032 battery, and smart alerts through a compatible Aqara hub. A practical Smart Water Leak Sensor for home protection.
aqara-water-leak-sensor.description:
Aqara Water Leak Sensor –
Smart Water Leak Detection

The Aqara Water Leak Sensor
is a compact smart home device designed
to detect unwanted water in areas
where leaks can cause property damage.
It helps monitor locations near sinks,
washing machines, water heaters,
and household plumbing.

Two metal sensing probes
on the underside of the device
detect water contact.
When connected to a compatible hub,
the sensor can activate mobile alerts
and supported automation routines.

This Smart Water Leak Sensor
combines Zigbee connectivity,
IP67 water and dust resistance,
and low-power battery operation
in a compact wireless design.

It can be integrated into
a connected home system
to support early leak awareness
and faster responses
to potential water damage.

Water Leak Detection
Zigbee
IP67 Protection
Smart Alerts
CR2032 Battery
Home Automation

Early Water Leak Detection

The device uses metal contact probes
to detect water when it reaches
the sensing points underneath
the housing.

It can respond to water levels
as low as approximately
0.5 mm
under suitable detection conditions.

This makes it useful for monitoring
small water accumulations
that may otherwise remain unnoticed.

Real-Time Leak Notifications

When water is detected,
the sensor sends an event
to a compatible smart home hub.

Depending on the selected setup,
the system can provide
mobile notifications,
activate a hub alarm,
or trigger supported automation.

Remote notifications require
a correctly configured application,
compatible hub,
and suitable network connection.

IP67 Water and Dust Resistance

The sensor features
an IP67-rated housing
for protection against dust
and water exposure
under specified test conditions.

This makes it suitable for use
in humid indoor environments,
including kitchens,
bathrooms, and utility rooms.

IP67 protection does not mean
the device should remain
permanently submerged in water.

Compact Wireless Design

With dimensions of
50 × 50 × 15 mm,
the sensor is easy to position
in small monitoring areas.

It can be placed on a flat surface
under a sink,
beside a washing machine,
or near indoor plumbing equipment.

No permanent wiring
or drilling is required
for normal placement.

Key Features of the Water Leak Sensor

  • Sensitive Water Detection:
    Detects water reaching
    the metal contact probes.
  • Smart Notifications:
    Supports mobile leak alerts
    through a compatible hub.
  • Zigbee Connectivity:
    Low-power wireless communication
    for connected-home systems.
  • IP67 Protection:
    Resistance to dust
    and water exposure as rated.
  • Long Battery Life:
    Uses a replaceable CR2032 battery
    with approximately two years
    of typical operation.
  • Compact Housing:
    Convenient placement near
    household appliances and pipes.
  • Smart Automation:
    Can trigger compatible alarms
    or connected device actions.
  • Easy Installation:
    Wireless design with
    simple surface placement.

How the Water Detection System Works

The sensor monitors
the electrical connection
between the metal probes
on its underside.

When water touches both contacts,
it can register a leak event
and communicate the change
to a compatible hub.

The system can then respond
with an alert or another
configured smart home action.

The device detects water
only where its probes
can physically contact it.
It does not measure water flow
inside pipes or locate
the exact source of a leak.

Smart Home Automation and Water Protection

An Aqara Water Leak Detector
can be included in supported
smart home security
and automation routines.

For example, water detected
under a kitchen sink
can trigger a notification
or activate an audible alarm
through a suitable hub.

The system can also be connected
to a compatible smart water
valve controller to support
automatic water shutoff.

Important:
The sensor cannot close
a water valve by itself.
Automatic shutoff requires
a separate compatible valve,
proper installation,
and a configured automation.

Zigbee Wireless Connectivity

The Zigbee Water Leak Sensor
uses a low-power wireless protocol
to communicate with a compatible hub.

This reduces the need
for electrical wiring
and makes the device suitable
for battery-powered monitoring.

Actual wireless range depends
on walls, obstacles,
interference, and hub placement.

After installation,
test the connection
to confirm that alerts
can be received reliably.

Mobile Monitoring and Leak Alerts

Compatible smart home applications
can report changes between
dry conditions
and detected water contact.

This allows users to monitor
vulnerable areas of the home
and respond to unexpected leaks.

The exact notifications
and automation options depend
on the hub, application,
account, and selected ecosystem.

The sensor itself does not contain
a built-in audible siren.
Sound alerts require
a suitable connected device.

Long Battery Life with CR2032

The device operates using
a replaceable
CR2032 lithium battery.

Typical battery life
is approximately two years,
although actual operation
may vary depending
on environmental conditions
and wireless activity.

The low-power Zigbee design
helps reduce maintenance
and eliminates the need
for a permanent power cable.

Follow the manufacturer’s
instructions when replacing
the battery.

Simple Placement and Installation

Place the sensor
on a suitable flat surface
where leaked water
is likely to accumulate.

Common locations include
the area beneath kitchen sinks,
near washing machines,
beside water heaters,
and around indoor plumbing.

Make sure the sensing probes
can come into contact
with accumulating water.

Once positioned,
confirm communication
with the compatible hub
and test the configured alerts.

Common Uses Around the Home

In kitchens, the device
can monitor areas beneath sinks
and near dishwashers.

In bathrooms, it can be placed
near water heaters
or plumbing connections
where minor leaks may occur.

It can also be used
in utility rooms,
laundry areas,
and indoor storage spaces
with water pipes or appliances.

Choose the installation position
based on where water
is most likely to collect,
rather than relying only
on proximity to a pipe.

Smart Home Compatibility

The Aqara Water Sensor
requires a compatible Aqara hub
to enable connected notifications
and automation features.

Depending on the hub
and software configuration,
selected functions may also
be available through Apple Home
or other supported ecosystems.

The device does not connect
directly to a smartphone
using Wi-Fi.

Compatibility with
third-party Zigbee hubs
should not be assumed
without specific verification.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Product Name Aqara Water Leak Sensor
Brand Aqara
Model SJCGQ11LM
Device Type Water Leak Detector

cordless-smart-hotel-door-lock.description:

The Cordless Hotel Door Lock provides a practical room-access solution for hotels, serviced apartments, hospitality properties, and tourism accommodation.   • The lock itself does not require direct network or power wiring to the door.
  • Helps simplify installation compared with wired access systems.
  • Suitable for new hospitality projects and renovation projects.
  • Maintains a clean door appearance without visible wiring.

Designed for Hospitality

The Cordless Hotel Door Lock is suitable for hotels, serviced apartments, and hospitality properties that need organized RFID card access for guest rooms without relying entirely on conventional keys.

Centralized Card Management

The lock can be used as part of a hotel access solution for issuing and managing RFID cards and assigning room-access permissions. Available management functions depend on the compatible software and card-encoding equipment used in the project.

How Does the Hotel Access Solution Work?

The door lock is one component of the hotel access solution rather than the complete system. In a compatible hotel installation, the workflow can include:

  • 1. Management Software: Used to manage rooms, access cards, and permissions according to the selected hotel access system.
  • 2. Card Encoder / Reader: A compatible device is used to read or encode access cards according to the system configuration.
  • 3. RFID Guest Card: An RFID card is prepared with the appropriate room-access permission for the guest or authorized user.
  • 4. Hotel Door Lock: The guest presents the authorized RFID card to access the assigned room.
  • 5. Guest Access Management: The system helps hotel staff organize card issuance and room-access permissions according to the capabilities of the selected management system.

Hotel Access Solution Components

Hotel Management Software Compatible management software for organizing rooms, access cards, and permissions according to the selected system.
Card Encoder / Reader A compatible device used to read or encode the RFID cards used by the access system.
RFID Cards Access cards used to provide guests or authorized users with room-access permissions.
Hotel Door Lock Cordless Hotel Door Lock used to control access to the guest room.

Suitable for Short-Term Hospitality Accommodation

The lock can also be suitable for serviced apartments, tourism accommodation, and other hospitality properties that use RFID card access, helping organize guest access while reducing dependence on traditional keys.

Door Installation & Compatibility

The absence of direct door wiring helps simplify installation. However, door type, door thickness, installation dimensions, and mortise requirements should be confirmed before installation to ensure compatibility with the lock.

Key Features

  • RFID card access.
  • Designed for hotel room access solutions.
  • No direct network or power wiring required at the door lock.

Digiline MX — 8×8 Digital Matrix Signal Processor

Digiline MX processor is an 8×8 digital audio matrix signal processor that provides signal routing and processing without a built-in power amplifier. It is intended for installations where an external amplifier is used or higher output power is required.

Remote control is supported via ASCII commands over RS232 and TCP/IP. The unit also provides 12 GPIO ports and programmable automation for presets, output mutes and master control.

Matrix Processing
8×8 digital matrix for routing and processing audio—processing-only design intended to be used with external amplification.
Remote Control & Protocol
Control the unit remotely using ASCII commands over RS232 or TCP/IP for integration with external control systems.
GPIO & Automation
Twelve GPIO inputs/outputs allow expanded control and automated actions such as preset changes, output mute (including conditional mutes) and master control.
Setup & Documentation
WorkCAD3 configurator and the DIGILINE MX User Manual are available for download to assist with system setup and programming.

Suitable Use Cases

  • Fixed installations where existing amplifiers are retained and digital signal routing/processing is required
  • Commercial audio systems (restaurants, retail, hospitality) needing matrix routing and remote control
  • Educational and event venues requiring programmable presets and centralized control
  • Integrations with external control systems via RS232 or TCP/IP for automation

Generic 4K 120M HDMI KVM Extender Over Ethernet

The Generic 4K 120M HDMI KVM Extender
is designed to transmit compatible HDMI
video signals and extend USB keyboard
and mouse control over Cat5e or Cat6
network cabling.

The system uses a transmitter (TX)
near the source device and a receiver (RX)
near the remote display. This configuration
allows equipment to remain in a separate
room while operators access its video
and compatible controls remotely.

With advertised support for resolutions
up to 4K and transmission distances
up to 120 meters, this HDMI extension
solution is suitable for selected
monitoring rooms, CCTV installations,
professional workstations and
meeting spaces.

Actual signal performance depends on
the source, display, cable quality and
installation conditions. The exact
4K refresh rate and HDMI version
should be confirmed before purchase.


4K HDMI Video
Extend compatible HDMI video
with resolution support
advertised up to 4K.
Up to 120m Extension
Transmit signals over suitable
Cat5e or Cat6 network cable
for distances up to 120 meters.
USB KVM Control
Use a supported keyboard and
mouse to operate equipment
from a remote location.
Transmitter and Receiver
Separate TX and RX units provide
the connection between the HDMI
source and remote display.

Key Features of the HDMI KVM Extender

  • Extends HDMI video over compatible network cabling.
  • Supports video resolution up to 4K as advertised.
  • Offers a stated maximum transmission distance of 120m.
  • Provides USB keyboard and mouse control.
  • Uses dedicated transmitter and receiver units.
  • Supports suitable Cat5e and Cat6 cables.
  • Enables flexible positioning of source and display equipment.
  • Can be used in compatible CCTV, office and control-room installations.

How the HDMI KVM Extender Works

A compatible HDMI source connects to
the transmitter unit. The receiver
connects to the distant HDMI display.
The two units are linked using
suitable network cable.

With the required USB connections,
supported keyboard and mouse controls
can be used at the receiver location.
This is helpful when the source device
must remain in an equipment room.

The exact cable layout, power supply
and USB port configuration must match
the supplied device instructions.
A successful installation should be
tested at the required video resolution.

High-Resolution 4K HDMI Transmission

refresh rate. The existing product

whether the model supports

audio capabilities and HDR support
should also be verified when
these features are essential
to the installation.

Long-Distance HDMI Extension up to 120m

The advertised transmission range
is up to 120 meters, allowing source
equipment and operator displays
to be placed in separate locations.

However, the actual achievable range
can be affected by cable category,
conductor quality, terminations,
signal format and environmental
interference.

For commercial installations,
testing the complete cable run
before handover helps confirm
stable video and USB operation.

Remote Keyboard and Mouse Operation

KVM functionality is particularly
useful when users need to control
a compatible computer, recorder
or workstation while viewing
its output on a distant display.

For example, a CCTV recording device
may be installed in a secured
equipment cabinet while its
monitoring screen and USB controls
are located at an operator desk.

Specialized USB devices, touchscreens
and other peripherals should not
be assumed compatible without
specific manufacturer confirmation.

Cat5e and Cat6 Network Cable Connection

The extender uses suitable
Cat5e or Cat6 cabling between
the transmitter and receiver.
This can simplify cable routing
in locations where direct
long-distance HDMI cabling
would be impractical.

Correct RJ45 termination and
appropriate cable quality are
important for reliable operation.
Damaged cables, poor connectors
and unsuitable routing may
affect signal stability.

Although the product uses
RJ45 connectors, this does
not automatically mean the
signal supports ordinary
Ethernet switching, IP routing
or Power over Ethernet.

verified for the exact model.

TX and RX Transmitter-Receiver Setup

The TX unit is positioned
near the HDMI source and
is responsible for sending
the extended signal.

The RX unit receives
the signal near the remote
display and provides
the required connections
for viewing and supported
USB operation.

Both units should be installed
with suitable ventilation,
stable power and accessible
connections for maintenance.

HDMI KVM Extension for CCTV Systems

In a compatible CCTV installation,
an HDMI KVM extender can allow
the recording equipment to remain
in a secure technical room while
an operator uses a screen and
keyboard or mouse elsewhere.

This arrangement can help
separate sensitive equipment
from regular monitoring stations
without moving the main recorder.

The device itself does not record
or store video. Its role is to
extend compatible video and
input-control signals.

aqara-valve-controller-t1.shortDescription:
The Aqara Valve Controller T1 is a battery-powered smart water valve controller designed to automate compatible household water valves without additional electrical wiring.

This Zigbee valve actuator supports lever and butterfly valve handles on DN15, DN20 and DN25 pipes. It connects to the Aqara Home app through a compatible Aqara Zigbee hub.

Powered by four AA batteries with up to two years of battery life under specified conditions, the Valve Controller T1 supports scheduled water control and Matter integration through a compatible bridge.

When paired with a compatible water leak sensor and a configured automation, this smart water valve controller can automatically shut off the water supply when a leak is detected. Explore it at Aura Smart Home.

The Aqara Magic Switch S1E is a smart touchscreen wall switch designed to combine wired lighting control with convenient smart home scene management.

This Magic Switch S1E panel features a 480×480 touchscreen and supports three wired lighting circuits. It can also control compatible devices and automation scenes through Aqara Home.

The Aqara smart switch connects over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and supports Apple HomeKit. Its compact 86×86mm design is intended for compatible wall installations with live and neutral wiring.

Discover the Aura Aqara switch selection for stylish lighting control and everyday smart home convenience.
aqara-magic-switch-s1e.description:
Aqara Magic Switch S1E – Smart Touchscreen Wall Switch

The Aqara Magic Switch S1E is a
smart touchscreen wall switch
for lighting and scene control.

It combines direct switching
of three wired lighting circuits
with convenient control of
compatible smart home devices.

The Magic Switch S1E panel
features a 480×480 touchscreen
and a modern square design.

It connects over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi
and supports Aqara Home
and Apple HomeKit integration.

Touchscreen
480×480
Wi-Fi 2.4GHz
3 Lighting Circuits
Apple HomeKit

Smart Touchscreen Control

The touchscreen provides
convenient access to lighting
and smart control functions.

Its 480×480 resolution supports
a clear graphical interface.

Available controls can be
configured according to
supported Aqara Home settings.

Three Wired Lighting Circuits

The Aqara smart switch can
directly control three
compatible wired lighting loads.

The L1, L2 and L3 terminals
connect the lighting circuits.

Electrical loads must remain
within the manufacturer’s
specified limits.

Smart Scene Management

The panel can link supported
smart home devices and scenes.

This allows convenient
scene activation from
a wall-mounted control point.

Available automations depend
on compatible devices
and system configuration.

Wi-Fi & Apple HomeKit

The Magic Switch S1E uses
2.4GHz Wi-Fi connectivity.

It can be configured through
the Aqara Home application.

Apple HomeKit integration
is supported with the
appropriate setup.

The device is not a
Zigbee hub or Wi-Fi router.

Compact Wall-Mounted Design

The switch features a compact
86×86mm front panel.

Its modern appearance combines
lighting control and smart
scene access in one device.

Check wall-box depth and
wiring clearance before installation.

Electrical Installation Requirements

  • Connect the live supply to terminal L.
  • Connect the neutral wire to terminal N.
  • Connect lighting loads to L1, L2 and L3.
  • Disconnect mains power before installation.
  • Follow the manufacturer’s load ratings.
  • Use a qualified electrical installer.

The Aqara Magic Switch S1E requires
both live and neutral wiring.

Direct Lighting Control

The switch can control
three separate lighting circuits.

Its touchscreen also offers
supported smart scene controls.

The three physical load outputs
remain subject to their
specified electrical ratings.

The unit is not designed
for unlimited wired loads.

Recommended Applications

  • Living room lighting control.
  • Bedroom lighting management.
  • Compatible smart home scenes.
  • Fixed wall-mounted control locations.
  • Replacing compatible traditional switches.
  • Combining wired lighting and scene controls.

Key Features

  • 480×480 touchscreen display.
  • Three wired lighting circuits.
  • 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connectivity.
  • Aqara Home application support.
  • Apple HomeKit compatibility.
  • Smart device and scene linkage.
  • 86×86mm front-panel dimensions.
  • Suitable for indoor installation.

aqara-t1.shortDescription:
The Aqara Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1 is a compact Zigbee 3.0 smart sensor designed to monitor indoor temperature, relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure.

This Aqara T1 sensor offers temperature accuracy of ±0.3°C and humidity accuracy of ±3% RH. It runs on a replaceable CR2032 battery and features a compact 36 × 36 × 9mm design.

The Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1 connects to Aqara Home through a compatible Aqara Zigbee hub. It can help trigger smart home scenes, notifications, and climate-related automations using compatible devices.

Discover this Aqara sensor at Aura Smart Home for convenient indoor environmental monitoring and smarter home comfort.
aqara-t1.description:
Aqara Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1 – Zigbee 3.0

The Aqara Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1
is a compact smart device for monitoring
indoor environmental conditions.

It measures temperature,
relative humidity, and
atmospheric pressure.

This Aqara T1 sensor uses Zigbee 3.0
to communicate with a compatible
Aqara smart home hub.

Its measurements can support
smart home automation,
notifications, and climate monitoring.

Zigbee 3.0
Temperature
Humidity
Air Pressure
CR2032

Accurate Temperature Monitoring

The sensor measures temperatures
from -20°C to 50°C.

Its specified temperature
accuracy is ±0.3°C.

Measurements can be monitored
through Aqara Home when connected
to a compatible hub.

Humidity Measurement

The device monitors relative humidity
from 0 to 100% RH
in non-condensing conditions.

Its humidity accuracy is
rated at ±3% RH.

These measurements help users
understand indoor comfort levels
and humidity changes.

Atmospheric Pressure Monitoring

The Aqara sensor also measures
atmospheric pressure.

The supported pressure range
is 30 to 110 kPa.

Pressure measurement accuracy
is specified as ±0.12 kPa.

Zigbee 3.0 Connectivity

The Aqara T1 sensor uses
the Zigbee 3.0 wireless protocol.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub
is required to connect the sensor
to Aqara Home.

The sensor cannot connect directly
to a smartphone through
Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

Smart Climate Automation

Temperature and humidity readings
can be used to trigger
compatible smart home automations.

For example, a scene can be created
to turn on an air conditioner
when the temperature rises.

This requires a compatible
air-conditioning controller
and suitable hub configuration.

The sensor itself does not
operate or switch an air conditioner.

Notifications and Environmental Monitoring

Users can configure supported
notifications when environmental
conditions leave a preferred range.

Readings are available
through compatible Aqara Home
configurations.

Notification features depend on
the connected hub and
system settings.

Replaceable Battery

The Temperature and Humidity
Sensor T1 runs on
a CR2032 battery.

No mains wiring or
external power adapter is required.

Battery lifetime depends on
environmental conditions
and usage patterns.

Compact and Easy to Install

The sensor has a compact
36 × 36 × 9mm body.

It can be attached using
the supplied adhesive sticker
or placed in a suitable location.

Avoid mounting directly
on metal surfaces that may
interfere with Zigbee signals.

Recommended Applications

  • Living rooms and bedrooms.
  • Home offices and workspaces.
  • Children’s rooms in suitable conditions.
  • Indoor air-conditioning monitoring.
  • Compatible cooling and humidification scenes.
  • General indoor environmental monitoring.

Key Features

  • Temperature, humidity, and pressure measurements.
  • Zigbee 3.0 connectivity.
  • ±0.3°C temperature accuracy.
  • ±3% RH humidity accuracy.
  • Replaceable CR2032 battery.
  • Compact, adhesive-mountable design.
  • Aqara Home support through a compatible hub.
  • Smart home automation triggers.

aqara-presence-multi-sensor-fp300.shortDescription:
The Aqara Presence Sensor FP300 is a battery-powered 5-in-1 smart sensor combining PIR motion detection and 60GHz mmWave radar to detect movement and stationary presence, with coverage up to 6 meters and a 120° detection angle.

The Presence Multi-Sensor FP300 also measures ambient light, temperature, and humidity, enabling smart lighting and climate automation with compatible devices.

This Thread Zigbee sensor supports two selectable connectivity modes: Zigbee through a compatible Aqara Hub, or Thread with a compatible Matter Controller and Thread Border Router.

Powered by two replaceable CR2450 batteries, it offers up to 3 years of operation in Zigbee mode or 2 years in Thread mode under specified conditions. Explore Aqara smart sensors at Aura Smart Home.
aqara-presence-multi-sensor-fp300.description:
Aqara Presence Sensor FP300 – Smart Multi-Sensor

The Aqara Presence Sensor FP300
combines motion detection and
stationary presence sensing.

It uses PIR technology and
60GHz mmWave radar to
monitor activity accurately.

The Presence Multi-Sensor FP300
covers up to 6 meters
with a 120° detection angle.

It also monitors ambient light,
temperature, and humidity
for smarter home automation.

60GHz mmWave
PIR Detection
Zigbee & Thread
6m / 120°
2 × CR2450

Dual Presence Detection

The FP300 combines PIR sensing
with 60GHz mmWave radar.

PIR detects conventional
movement within the monitored area.

mmWave radar helps identify
stationary presence and
very subtle body movements.

Both technologies work together
to improve detection reliability.

Stationary Presence Monitoring

The sensor can detect people
who remain relatively still.

This makes it useful for
reading, working, or
watching television.

Compatible automation can
keep lighting active while
presence is detected.

Ambient Light Detection

The sensor includes an
ambient light measurement function.

Lighting conditions can be
combined with presence detection
in supported automation scenes.

For example, lights can turn on
when someone enters a room
and illumination is low.

Temperature & Humidity

The Thread Zigbee sensor
also monitors indoor temperature
and relative humidity.

These measurements can help
create comfortable indoor
climate automation routines.

A compatible climate controller
is required to operate
air conditioners or other equipment.

Zigbee & Thread Connectivity

The Aqara Presence Sensor FP300
supports Zigbee and Thread
as selectable connectivity modes.

Zigbee mode:
Requires a compatible Aqara Hub
and the Aqara Home application.

Thread mode:
Requires a compatible Matter Controller
and Thread Border Router.

The two protocols are alternative
operating modes rather than
simultaneous active connections.

Matter & Smart Home Ecosystems

The FP300 supports integration
with compatible Matter ecosystems.

Thread mode provides Matter
connectivity using the required
Thread network equipment.

Zigbee mode can provide Matter
integration through an Aqara Hub
with Matter bridge functionality.

Compatible platforms include
Apple Home, Google Home,
SmartThings, and other ecosystems.

Supported sensor functions
may differ between platforms.

AI-Powered Detection

The FP300 includes AI-based
detection improvements.

Spatial learning can help
the sensor adapt to
its installation environment.

This reduces interference
and improves presence reliability.

Advanced AI spatial learning
settings are supported through
Aqara Home in Zigbee mode.

Customizable Detection Settings

Zigbee mode provides additional
configuration options in Aqara Home.

  • Adjust supported detection range settings.
  • Configure absence delay.
  • Enable or disable selected sensing functions.
  • Adjust environmental reporting frequency.
  • Use AI spatial learning features.

Available options depend on
compatible firmware and app settings.

Replaceable Batteries

The sensor runs on two
replaceable CR2450 batteries.

Battery life reaches up to
3 years in Zigbee mode.

In Thread mode, it can
operate for up to 2 years.

Actual battery performance
varies with connected platforms,
reporting frequency, and usage.

Flexible Installation

The FP300 features a
fully rotatable mounting base.

It can be installed on
walls, ceilings, or corners.

Suitable magnetic mounting
surfaces may also be used.

Aqara recommends a 45°
corner installation angle
for improved coverage.

Smart Lighting & Climate Automation

Presence and illumination data
can trigger compatible
smart lighting scenes.

Temperature readings can also
support climate-control automation.

For example, cooling can
activate when presence is detected
and the room temperature is high.

The sensor does not directly
switch electrical loads.

Recommended Applications

  • Living rooms and bedrooms.
  • Offices and meeting rooms.
  • Indoor hallways and entrances.
  • Presence-based lighting automation.
  • Smart air-conditioning scenes.
  • Indoor temperature and humidity monitoring.
  • Energy-saving automation routines.

Key Features

  • Five sensing functions in one device.
  • Motion and stationary presence detection.
  • 60GHz mmWave radar combined with PIR.
  • Up to 6m detection range.
  • 120° detection angle.
  • Light, temperature, and humidity sensing.
  • Selectable Zigbee and Thread modes.
  • Matter integration with suitable equipment.
  • Two replaceable CR2450 batteries.
  • Flexible rotatable mounting base.
