aqara-dual-relay-module-t2.shortDescription:
The Aqara Dual Relay Module T2 is a compact two-channel smart relay designed to automate compatible lighting circuits, motors, and electrical equipment without replacing existing switches or devices.

This dual relay Zigbee module supports Zigbee 3.0, Dry Contact and Wet Contact modes, and Interlock Mode for compatible bidirectional motors, including certain curtain and shutter systems.

The Aqara Zigbee relay supports AC power from 100–250V and compatible DC supplies, with a maximum combined current of 10A across both channels. Selected AC-powered functions include energy monitoring, Power Memory, and configurable safety protection.

Designed for installation behind switches or on a DIN rail, this hidden relay module connects through a compatible Aqara Zigbee hub. Explore smart automation solutions at Aura Smart Home.
aqara-dual-relay-module-t2.description:
Aqara Dual Relay Module T2 – Hidden Zigbee Smart Relay

The Aqara Dual Relay Module T2
is a compact two-channel smart relay
for compatible electrical devices.

This dual relay Zigbee module
adds intelligent control
without replacing existing equipment.

It supports Dry Contact,
Wet Contact, and Interlock
modes for flexible applications.

The hidden relay connects
through a compatible
Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub.

Zigbee 3.0
Dual Relay
10A Total
Dry / Wet Contact
Interlock

Two-Channel Smart Control

The module provides
two relay channels
for compatible electrical loads.

Each output can be controlled
according to the configured
operating mode.

The maximum AC current
is 10A combined across
both channels.

The rating is not
10A per channel.

Zigbee 3.0 Connectivity

The Aqara Zigbee relay
uses Zigbee wireless
communication.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub
is required for Aqara Home control.

Users can create supported
schedules, scenes,
and smart automations.

Dry Contact Mode

Dry Contact Mode enables
control of compatible equipment
with dry-contact inputs.

It can be useful for
certain garage controllers,
motors, and control circuits.

Dry Contact wiring must follow
the official Aqara diagram.

The Wet Contact jumper
must be removed for this mode.

Wet Contact Mode

Wet Contact Mode supports
switching compatible
electrical loads.

The LIN and LOUT terminals
must be bridged using
the supplied jumper.

Wiring must follow the official
diagram and electrical ratings.

Interlock & Motor Control

The Aqara Dual Relay Module T2
supports Interlock Mode.

This mode is useful for
compatible bidirectional
motors and shutter systems.

Interlock prevents both
direction outputs from
operating simultaneously.

It must be enabled
and configured correctly
before operating motors.

Energy Monitoring

The module supports
energy monitoring under
its compatible operating conditions.

Readings can support
power-related automations
in Aqara Home.

Energy monitoring and
power automations require
AC-powered operation.

These features are not
necessarily exposed
to third-party ecosystems.

Power Memory

Power Memory allows
the relay to manage
its state after a power interruption.

Users can configure
supported recovery behavior
within the Aqara system.

Available settings depend
on the device configuration.

Overheat & Overload Protection

The T2 supports protection
against overheating
and electrical overload.

Customizable power limits
are available under
supported conditions.

These features do not replace
appropriate circuit breakers
or electrical safety devices.

Wireless Switch Mode

Wireless Switch Mode can
convert a compatible
existing wall switch
into a scene controller.

Selected wired sensors
may also be integrated.

This function requires
AC power and Aqara Home.

It is not necessarily available
through third-party platforms.

HomeKit & Matter Integration

The relay supports integration
with compatible Apple HomeKit
smart home configurations.

Matter compatibility is provided
through a compatible Aqara hub
acting as a Matter bridge.

Google Home and Amazon Alexa
integration depends on the
hub and platform setup.

The T2 itself is not
a Matter over Thread device.

Compact Hidden Installation

The hidden relay module
fits compatible wall boxes
and electrical enclosures.

It can be installed
behind a switch,
near a lighting load,
or using a DIN rail accessory.

Aqara recommends approximately
60mm of wall-box depth
for adequate installation space.

Electrical clearance,
heat management, and wiring
must be considered.

Recommended Applications

  • Adding smart control to existing lighting circuits.
  • Controlling two compatible electrical loads.
  • Operating suitable bidirectional shutter motors.
  • Integrating equipment with dry-contact inputs.
  • Creating schedules and automation scenes.
  • Monitoring energy in supported AC installations.
  • Hidden installation in wall boxes or control panels.

Key Features

  • Two-channel smart relay module.
  • Zigbee 3.0 connectivity.
  • Dry Contact and Wet Contact modes.
  • Interlock support for compatible motors.
  • AC and DC operating options.
  • 10A maximum combined AC current.
  • Energy monitoring in AC mode.
  • Power Memory function.
  • Overheat and overload protection.
  • Hidden or DIN rail installation.

aqara-cube-t1-pro.shortDescription:
The Aqara Cube T1 Pro is a wireless smart home controller that lets you trigger devices and automation scenes through intuitive gestures, including rotating, shaking, pushing, and flipping the cube.

This Zigbee smart cube supports two selectable modes: Scene Mode, which uses its six numbered faces for different smart home scenes, and Action Mode for gesture-based control.

As a HomeKit cube controller, it can work with Apple Home, Alexa, and IFTTT through compatible Aqara hub integrations, with supported actions varying by ecosystem.

The Aqara Cube controller uses Zigbee connectivity and requires a compatible Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub. It runs on a replaceable CR2450 battery with up to two years of battery life.

Explore flexible smart lighting, curtain, and automation control with Aqara Cube T1 Pro at Aura Smart Home.

Aqara Cube T1 Pro is a wireless Zigbee smart cube
designed for intuitive smart home scene control.

Aqara Cube T1 Pro – 6-Sided Smart Controller

This Aqara Cube controller lets you trigger
compatible devices through simple cube movements.

Use the six numbered faces to activate
different lighting, curtain, and automation scenes.

The HomeKit cube controller supports Scene Mode
and a separate Action Mode for gesture-based control.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub is required
for pairing and smart home integration.

Six-Sided Control
Zigbee
Scene Mode
Action Mode
HomeKit Compatible
Up to 2 Years

Product Overview

The Aqara Cube T1 Pro is a compact
six-sided wireless smart home controller.

It allows users to activate scenes
without opening a smartphone application.

The cube uses motion sensing
to recognize supported physical actions.

Its low-power design supports
long battery life and OTA updates.

Operation Modes

The controller offers two selectable
operating modes.

  • Scene Mode:
    Uses six numbered faces to trigger
    different smart home scenes.
  • Action Mode:
    Supports gesture-based controls
    inside the Aqara Home application.
  • Mode Selection:
    The two operating modes cannot
    be active simultaneously.

Available actions depend on
the selected mode and connected ecosystem.

Recognized Gestures

Action Mode supports several
physical gestures for automation.

  • Push the cube across a surface.
  • Shake the cube to trigger an action.
  • Rotate it for compatible adjustments.
  • Tap the cube twice.
  • Flip it by 90°.
  • Flip it by 180°.
  • Trigger an event after one-minute inactivity.

Scene Mode also supports
selected actions with different faces facing up.

Lighting & Curtain Control

Control compatible smart lighting
and motorized curtains using the cube.

  • Assign a face to a lighting scene.
  • Rotate to adjust supported light brightness.
  • Adjust color temperature on compatible devices.
  • Trigger curtain opening or closing scenes.
  • Control supported curtain opening percentages.

Lighting and curtain functions require
compatible accessories and configured automations.

Six-Sided Scene Mode

Scene Mode makes smart home control
simple and easy to remember.

Each face has a numbered indicator,
similar to a traditional dice.

Assign different automations
to the six available faces.

For example, face one can activate
morning lighting and open the curtains.

Another face can activate
a relaxing evening scene.

Classic Action Mode

Action Mode provides familiar
gesture controls from the Aqara Cube family.

Push, shake, rotate, double-tap,
or flip the cube to trigger actions.

This mode works within
the Aqara Home ecosystem.

Action Mode cannot be used
at the same time as Scene Mode.

Connectivity & Ecosystems

The Zigbee smart cube communicates
through a compatible Aqara Zigbee hub.

It does not connect directly
to a standard Wi-Fi router.

  • Aqara Home for device pairing and configuration.
  • Apple Home through compatible hub integration.
  • Amazon Alexa through supported integrations.
  • IFTTT through compatible Aqara services.

Platform compatibility and available
controls depend on the hub and configuration.

HomeKit Cube Controller

The Aqara Cube T1 Pro can work
as a HomeKit cube controller.

In Scene Mode, its six faces
can be configured as wireless buttons.

Each button can activate
a compatible Apple Home scene.

A supported Aqara hub with
Apple Home integration is required.

Not every gesture available in
Aqara Home is exposed to Apple Home.

Amazon Alexa Integration

The Aqara Cube controller can
support Alexa routines.

With the supported cloud integration,
its six faces can appear as
six virtual motion sensors.

Changing the active cube face
can trigger the associated routine.

Availability depends on
the hub, region, and integration settings.

Matter Compatibility

Matter support depends on
a compatible Aqara hub
with Matter bridge functionality.

The cube itself remains
a Zigbee device rather than
a standalone Matter over Thread accessory.

Check the selected hub,
firmware version, and Matter ecosystem
for supported cube functions.

Not all actions are guaranteed
to be exposed through Matter.

Integrations & Automations

Create practical automations
through the Aqara Home app.

  • Assign scenes to individual cube faces.
  • Use gestures to activate supported devices.
  • Control compatible lighting and curtains.
  • Activate Apple Home scenes where supported.
  • Trigger compatible Alexa routines.
  • Combine the cube with other Aqara accessories.

The controller sends commands
through the connected smart home system.

It does not directly power
lights, motors, or other electrical equipment.

Power & Firmware

The controller uses one
replaceable CR2450 battery.

Its low-power design offers
up to two years of battery life.

Actual battery life depends
on usage and operating conditions.

The device also supports
over-the-air firmware updates.

OTA updates can deliver
supported improvements and fixes.

Camera Hub G3 Integration

The Cube T1 Pro can be paired
with a compatible Aqara Camera Hub G3.

The G3 includes a Zigbee hub,
so a separate Zigbee gateway
is not required in that setup.

Cube actions can trigger
supported Camera Hub G3 automations.

  • Activate the camera’s Gesture Recognition mode.
  • Trigger a preset camera orientation.
  • Enable supported privacy protection scenes.
  • Combine camera actions with other smart scenes.

These functions depend on
Aqara Home configuration
and compatible G3 firmware.

Smart Lighting Applications

Use the cube to simplify
everyday lighting control.

A selected face can
activate a reading scene.

Another face can start
a movie lighting preset.

With compatible Aqara lighting,
rotation can adjust brightness
or supported color settings.

Smart Curtain Applications

The cube can control
compatible smart curtain systems.

Assign actions to open,
stop, or close the curtains.

Supported configurations also allow
adjustment of curtain opening percentages.

Curtain automation requires
a compatible motor or curtain driver.

Suitable Uses

  • Quick scene switching throughout the home.
  • Morning and evening automation routines.
  • Smart lighting brightness adjustment.
  • Compatible curtain and roller shade control.
  • Movie, reading, and relaxation scenes.
  • Triggering supported robot vacuum routines.
  • Activating compatible Alexa and Apple Home scenes.
  • Controlling selected Camera Hub G3 functions.
  • Operating supported fans and climate accessories.

These are configurable use cases
and require suitable connected devices.

Key Features

  • Six-sided smart cube with numbered indicators.
  • Wireless Zigbee connectivity.
  • Selectable Scene Mode and Action Mode.
  • Multiple gesture-based controls.
  • Apple Home scene control with compatible hub.
  • Support for selected Alexa and IFTTT integrations.
  • Smart lighting and curtain automation.
  • Integration with Camera Hub G3.
  • Replaceable CR2450 battery.
  • Battery life of up to two years.
  • OTA firmware update support.
  • Compact design for indoor use.

The Aqara Cube T1 Pro is ideal
for smart homes using Aqara accessories.

It provides convenient control
without relying on a phone
for every daily action.

Pair it with a compatible
Aqara Zigbee hub to configure
supported scenes and gestures.

Integrations with Apple Home,
Alexa, and other platforms
depend on the selected hub.

Aqara Cube Controller at Aura Smart Home

Discover the Aqara Cube T1 Pro
at Aura Smart Home.

This Zigbee smart cube makes
lighting and curtain automation
more interactive.

The Aqara Cube controller
offers convenient scene control

Explore compatible Aqara smart home
products and automation solutions
at Aura.

Connected devices and configured scenes

aqara-e1.shortDescription:
The Aqara Curtain Drive E1 (Curtain Driver E1 Track Version) is a compact smart curtain motor designed to automate compatible existing curtain tracks without replacing the entire system.

This track curtain motor supports U-rail and I-rail installations and can move compatible curtains weighing up to 12 kg.

The Zigbee curtain motor features Zigbee 3.0 connectivity, a rechargeable battery, USB-C power, and up to one year of battery life depending on operating conditions.

A built-in ambient light sensor enables brightness-based automation. Users can also create schedules, scenes, and voice controls through a compatible Aqara Zigbee hub.

Upgrade your curtains with an Aqara smart curtain motor from Aura Smart Home.

for compatible existing curtain tracks.

Aqara Curtain Driver E1 – Smart Track Curtain Motor

The Curtain Driver E1 (Track Version)
adds automatic opening and closing
to compatible U-rail and I-rail curtains.

This Zigbee curtain motor uses Zigbee 3.0
and supports curtain loads up to 12 kg.

It features a rechargeable battery,
USB-C power, and an ambient light sensor.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub
is required for smart home control.

6000 mAh*

Battery & Power

The Aqara Curtain Driver E1
uses a built-in rechargeable
lithium battery.

Aura lists a 6000 mAh battery
for this product version.

The actual battery specification
should be checked against the
supplied regional model.

Battery life can reach
up to one year between charges.

A USB-C port supports
charging or suitable continuous power.

Connectivity & Ecosystems

The track curtain motor
communicates through Zigbee 3.0.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub
is required for pairing and automation.

  • Apple Home with compatible Aqara hub integration.
  • Amazon Alexa through supported integrations.
  • Google Home through supported integrations.
  • IFTTT and other platforms where supported.
  • Matter integration where the hub and ecosystem support bridging.

Track Compatibility

The Track Version is designed
for compatible U-rail and I-rail systems.

  • U-rail bottom slot width: 8 mm or less.
  • I-rail bottom width: 10 mm or more.
  • Rail shape must allow smooth glider movement.
  • U-rail gliders without wheels are not supported.
  • End stops and mounting accessories must be compatible.
  • Extendable rods are not suitable for this Track Version.

Measure the actual track
before purchasing.

Load & Performance

The smart curtain motor can
move curtains weighing up to 12 kg.

Actual performance depends on
curtain weight, track length,
and mechanical friction.

Suitable double-opening curtains
may use two drivers with
compatible configuration.

Two drivers do not guarantee
longer battery life in every setup.

Installation

The Curtain Driver E1 mounts
onto a compatible existing curtain track.

In many installations, it can
remain hidden behind the curtain fabric.

  • Check the rail profile and dimensions.
  • Attach the correct track glider accessories.
  • Mount the unit following Aqara instructions.
  • Pair the motor with a compatible Aqara hub.
  • Calibrate opening and closing positions.
  • Test operation before enabling automations.

The system is designed
for convenient retrofit installation.

Controls & Automation

Control the curtains from
the Aqara Home application.

Create schedules and scenes
for daily curtain operation.

  • Open or close curtains at selected times.
  • Use compatible Siri, Alexa, or Google voice commands.
  • Trigger movement with supported Aqara switches.
  • Combine curtain scenes with compatible sensors.
  • Schedule movement around sunrise and sunset.
  • Use supported geofencing or app automation options.
  • Integrate with additional platforms where supported.

Built-in Light Sensor

The Curtain Driver E1 includes
a built-in ambient light sensor.

This sensor supports
brightness-based curtain automation.

For example, curtains can
close automatically when
ambient brightness exceeds
a configured condition.

Such scenes help manage
natural light, comfort, and privacy.

Manual Pull Operation

The motor can support
manual-pull starting behavior
when configured appropriately.

Gently moving the curtain
can initiate powered movement
in supported setups.

This feature depends on
calibration and device settings.

Multiple Driver Setup

Two compatible Curtain Driver E1
units can be used in selected
center-opening curtain systems.

The arrangement may help
control each curtain panel.

Installation and calibration
must match the track and curtain layout.

Actual speed and operating life
depend on the configuration.

Matter & Smart Home Integration

The Aqara Curtain Driver E1
is a Zigbee accessory,
not a standalone Matter over Thread device.

Matter compatibility depends on
an Aqara hub supporting Matter bridge
and the connected ecosystem.

Supported curtain functions
can differ between smart home platforms.

Check hub firmware and
device support before purchasing
for a particular Matter setup.

Suitable Uses

  • Automate morning curtain-opening routines.
  • Close curtains when sunlight becomes intense.
  • Control privacy while away from home.
  • Create bedtime and movie-mode curtain scenes.
  • Retrofit compatible U-rail or I-rail tracks.
  • Automate curtains weighing up to 12 kg.
  • Integrate curtains with smart switches and sensors.

Key Features

  • Zigbee 3.0 wireless connectivity.
  • Built-in rechargeable lithium battery.
  • 6000 mAh capacity listed for Aura’s product version.
  • Up to one-year battery life under suitable conditions.
  • USB-C charging and compatible continuous powering.
  • Maximum curtain load of 12 kg.
  • Support for compatible U-rail and I-rail tracks.
  • Built-in ambient light sensor.
  • Scheduling and scene automation.
  • Voice control through supported ecosystems.
  • Retrofit installation without replacing compatible tracks.

aqara-smoke-detector.shortDescription:
The Aqara Smoke Detector is a smart smoke alarm designed for early smoke detection, featuring an integrated siren rated up to 85 dB in supported regional variants and a flashing LED indicator.

This Zigbee smoke alarm uses Zigbee 3.0 and requires a compatible Aqara hub for smartphone notifications, smart home automations, and connected alert functions.

The smart smoke detector supports multi-device alarm grouping with compatible Aqara detectors and can activate siren-equipped Aqara hubs.

Its long-life battery system offers up to 10 years of operation under specified testing conditions, with actual performance varying by regional model and usage.

Matter smoke alarm integration is available through a compatible Aqara Matter bridge and Matter controller, subject to ecosystem support. Explore Aqara smart safety solutions at Aura Smart Home.
aqara-smoke-detector.description:
Aqara Smoke Detector is a smart smoke alarm
designed to detect smoke and provide local alerts.

Aqara Smoke Detector – Zigbee Smart Smoke Alarm

This Zigbee smoke alarm
combines smoke sensing
with an integrated audible siren.

The built-in alarm reaches
up to 85 dB in supported
regional versions.

It also includes a flashing
LED indicator for visual alerts.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub
enables smartphone notifications
and supported smart home automations.

Zigbee 3.0
Up to 85 dB
Up to 10 Years
Grouped Alerts
Matter Bridge

Alarm & LED

The smart smoke detector
includes a built-in audible alarm.

Its siren can reach
up to 85 dB in the
supported regional variant.

A colored LED flashes
during an alarm event.

Actual siren specifications
depend on the product version.

Connectivity & Hub

The detector uses Zigbee 3.0
wireless communication.

A compatible Aqara Zigbee hub
is required for connected functions.

The hub supports app notifications
and smart home automation.

The device is not
a standalone Wi-Fi detector.

Local & Remote Alerts

The smoke detector provides
local audible and visual alerts.

It can also activate compatible
siren-equipped Aqara hubs.

Aqara Home can deliver
configurable phone notifications.

Critical Alerts may be available
in supported phone configurations.

Battery & Power

The detector is designed
for long battery life.

Aqara’s global specification
lists DC 3V and CR17450 batteries.

Battery life can reach
up to 10 years under
specified testing conditions.

Verify the regional unit
for the exact battery arrangement.

Photoelectric Smoke Detection

The detector uses light scattering
to identify smoke particles.

As smoke concentration increases,
the optical sensor response changes.

An alarm is triggered
when the detection threshold is reached.

This is a smoke detector,
not a carbon monoxide detector.

Grouping & Automations

Compatible Aqara Smoke Detectors
can be grouped through Aqara Home.

When one grouped detector
senses smoke, other linked
detectors can also sound their alarms.

This feature helps extend
audible alert coverage across
multiple rooms.

Additional automations can trigger
compatible lights or camera actions.

Smart Home Notifications

The detector can send
smartphone notifications
through Aqara Home.

Supported siren-equipped hubs
can provide additional alerts.

Remote notifications depend on
network access, app permissions,
and connected services.

The local audible alarm
remains the primary on-site warning.

Disarm & Controls

The device offers supported
alarm-silencing controls in Aqara Home.

A compatible Aqara Mini Switch
can also be configured
for selected actions.

Aqara describes an
OK gesture with Camera Hub G3
for supported alarm controls.

Always assess the hazard
before silencing an alarm.

Never dismiss an alarm
when a real fire may be present.

Design & Safety

The detector features
a compact circular design.

It includes a single control button,
a visible LED indicator,
and an insect-resistant mesh.

Its enclosure uses
flame-retardant materials.

The unit measures
104.6 mm in diameter
and 42 mm in height.

Matter & Third-Party Integration

Matter smoke alarm integration
is supported through compatible
Aqara Matter bridge configurations.

A compatible Aqara hub
and a Matter controller
are required for the chosen ecosystem.

Potential platforms include
Apple Home, Google Home,
Alexa, and SmartThings.

Feature exposure varies
by controller and platform.

The detector itself communicates
using Zigbee, not Thread.

Smart Home Automation Examples

Smoke alerts can be used
as automation triggers
within supported Aqara configurations.

  • Activate compatible indoor lighting.
  • Trigger a compatible camera preset.
  • Send notifications to connected devices.
  • Activate additional Aqara hub sirens.
  • Link multiple compatible smoke detectors.

Automation is supplementary
to proper fire safety procedures.

Suitable Uses

  • Smoke monitoring in suitable indoor rooms.
  • Connected smoke alarm coverage across multiple areas.
  • Smartphone alerts when away from home.
  • Integration with supported Aqara automations.
  • Activation of compatible lights and camera scenes.
  • Additional alerts through compatible smart home platforms.

Always follow applicable
installation and fire safety requirements.

Key Features

  • Photoelectric smoke sensing.
  • Built-in siren rated up to 85 dB by regional version.
  • Flashing LED alarm indicator.
  • Zigbee 3.0 wireless connectivity.
  • Up to 10 years of battery life under test conditions.
  • Compatible multi-device alarm grouping.
  • Local siren and remote app notifications.
  • Aqara Home automation support.
  • Matter integration through compatible hub bridging.
  • One-button design and insect-resistant mesh.
  • Flame-retardant enclosure materials.

sonoff-dw2-wifi-smart-door-and-window-se.shortDescription: The SONOFF DW2 Wi-Fi door or window sensor, which requires no gate, provides instant alerts, data logs, and camera connectivity, with support for Alexa and Google via Wi-Fi Direct.
sonoff-dw2-wifi-smart-door-and-window-se.description:
The SONOFF DW2 Wi-Fi sensor lets you monitor the status of your doors and windows in real time, sending instant alerts when they open or close. No gateway or hub is needed; all you need is the eWeLink app and a Wi-Fi network.

Key Features

No Zigbee gateway or Hub needed.
The sensor connects directly to the eWeLink app via Bluetooth for setup, and operates on Wi-Fi for direct control and monitoring without the need for any intermediate devices.

Instant door/window status alerts
The app instantly displays the “open” or “closed” status, giving you peace of mind by keeping track of important entry points in your home or office.

Low battery alert and usage history
Includes a smart in-app alert when the battery level is low, as well as saving a log of events for up to 3 months to easily review opening and closing actions.

Connecting with smart cameras
The sensor can be linked with cameras supported in the eWeLink app, allowing you to check what is actually happening when you receive an open/close alert.

Easy installation without tools
It is installed using double-sided adhesive, making it easy to install on door or window frames without the need for drilling or cables.

Compatible with voice assistants
Supports integration with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, allowing you to ask the voice assistant about the status of doors and windows at any time.

Technical specifications

  • Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4GHz

  • Connection method: Bluetooth setup

  • App: eWeLink

  • Battery: Included in the package

  • Composition: 3M adhesive

  • Data log: Up to 3 months

  • Compatibility: Alexa, Google Assistant, Home Assistant (via eWeLink integration)

tuya-zigbee-matter-thread-gateway-smart-.description:
Introducing the Matter wired gateway – the ultimate smart home companion. Supporting up to 128 sub-devices, this gateway offers seamless compatibility with various smart platforms, enabling hands-free voice control. Enjoy the stability of a wired network that ensures a reliable connection every time, eliminating the problems of frequent disconnections. We prioritize security, employing two-factor encryption using the TLS protocol with device-level random keys to encrypt and store data locally.

Features

  • Matter Protocol:
    The gateway supports many major platforms such as Apple HomeKit, Google Assistant, SmartThings and Amazon Alexa, allowing you to use your preferred smart platform to control Matter-compatible devices.

  • ZigBee Gateway:
    It also functions as a ZigBee gateway, allowing it to add up to 128 sub-devices and connect ZigBee devices throughout the home, providing flexibility and ease of use.

  • Internet of Everything:
    Seamlessly connects with smart home devices on various platforms; whether they are lamps or sockets, to provide unified control and management of all your devices.

  • Connection stability: The wired network ensures a stable and reliable connection without interruption, protecting your smart home experience.

  • Wide network coverage:
    Provides seamless connectivity without obstructions or signal fading, with the effective control distance between the gateway and sub-devices reaching more than 200 meters in open areas.

  • Security and privacy protection:
    The gateway relies on two-way encryption using the TLS protocol, where business data is encrypted using random keys at the device level and stored locally to ensure the security of your information.

tuya-wifi-ir.description:
أصبح التحكم في الأجهزة المنزلية أكثر سهولة وذكاءً مع جهاز التحكم عن بعد الذكي بالأشعة تحت الحمراء (Smart Universal IR Remote)، الذي يسمح لك بإدارة مختلف الأجهزة المنزلية مثل التلفزيون، مكيف الهواء، المراوح، صناديق التلفزيون (STB)، مشغلات DVD وغيرها، مباشرةً من هاتفك الذكي أو عبر الأوامر الصوتية. بفضل دعمه لأشهر منصات المنزل الذكي مثل Amazon Alexa، Google Home، Yandex Alice، وSmart Life App، يمكنك التحكم في أجهزتك من أي مكان وفي أي وقت.

المزايا الرئيسية

🔹 تحكم شامل في جميع الأجهزة المنزلية بالأشعة تحت الحمراء

يعمل جهاز التحكم الذكي على تغطية أكثر من 98% من الأجهزة التي تستخدم تقنية الأشعة تحت الحمراء (IR)، مما يجعله بديلاً مثالياً لجهاز التحكم التقليدي، ويقلل من فوضى أجهزة التحكم المتعددة في المنزل.

🌐 اتصال Wi-Fi وتحكم عن بعد من أي مكان

  • بمجرد توصيل الجهاز بشبكة Wi-Fi 2.4GHz، يمكنك التحكم في جميع أجهزتك المنزلية عبر تطبيق Smart Life من هاتفك الذكي، حتى لو كنت خارج المنزل.
  • على سبيل المثال، يمكنك تشغيل مكيف الهواء قبل العودة إلى المنزل، أو إطفاء التلفزيون عن بُعد لضمان توفير الطاقة.

🗣 دعم التحكم الصوتي عبر Alexa وGoogle Assistant

  • يمكنك التحكم في الأجهزة بسهولة من خلال الأوامر الصوتية:
    • “Alexa, turn on the TV”
    • “OK Google, set the AC temperature to 25 degrees”
    • “Yandex Alice, turn off the fan”
  • هذه الميزة تجعل المنزل أكثر راحة وسهولة في الاستخدام، خاصة لكبار السن أو أصحاب الاحتياجات الخاصة.

📡 قاعدة بيانات ضخمة للأكواد ودعم التحديثات السحابية

  • يحتوي الجهاز على قاعدة بيانات ضخمة تضم أكثر من 4000 علامة تجارية و50,000 كود IR، ويتم تحديث مكتبة الأكواد باستمرار عبر السحابة، مما يضمن توافقه مع معظم الأجهزة المنزلية.
  • في حالة عدم العثور على الكود المناسب لجهازك، يمكنك استخدام ميزة التعلم الذكي (Learning Mode) لنسخ وظائف جهاز التحكم الأصلي.

🔄 أتمتة المنزل والجدولة الذكية

  • يمكنك إنشاء سيناريوهات أتمتة ذكية داخل التطبيق، مثل:
    • تشغيل مكيف الهواء عند تجاوز درجة الحرارة 28°C.
    • ضبط المروحة لتعمل تلقائيًا في أوقات محددة من اليوم.
    • تشغيل التلفزيون تلقائيًا عند بدء برنامجك المفضل.
  • يمكنك ضبط المؤقتات والجدولة الأسبوعية لتشغيل أو إيقاف الأجهزة في أوقات معينة، مما يعزز الراحة وكفاءة استهلاك الطاقة.

📍 تصميم مدمج ومدى تحكم واسع

  • يتميز الجهاز بتصميم 360° متعدد الاتجاهات، مما يضمن استجابة سريعة للأوامر من جميع زوايا الغرفة.
  • مدى التحكم عن بعد يصل إلى 12 مترًا، مما يجعله مثاليًا للغرف الكبيرة.
  • يُفضل تركيب جهاز لكل غرفة، نظرًا لأن الأشعة تحت الحمراء لا تخترق الجدران.

🏠 مشاركة التحكم مع أفراد العائلة

يمكنك مشاركة جهاز التحكم مع أفراد عائلتك عبر تطبيق Smart Life، بحيث يتمكن الجميع من التحكم في الأجهزة المنزلية بسهولة.

🔹 تنزيل التطبيق وتوصيل الجهاز

  1. قم بتحميل تطبيق Smart Life من متجر Google Play أو App Store.
  2. قم بتوصيل الجهاز بمصدر الطاقة عبر كابل USB.
  3. أضف الجهاز إلى التطبيق عبر ميزة البحث التلقائي أو Bluetooth.

  1. في التطبيق، حدد نوع الجهاز المراد التحكم فيه (مثل التلفزيون أو مكيف الهواء).
  2. اختر العلامة التجارية للجهاز أو استخدم ميزة التعلم الذكي إذا لم يكن الكود متاحًا.
  3. بعد الإعداد، يمكنك تشغيل وإيقاف الأجهزة وجدولة تشغيلها تلقائيًا.

🔹 التحكم الصوتي

  • قم بربط الجهاز مع حساب Amazon Alexa أو Google Home.

Advanced Smart Lock R7Y-TY

Where smart security meets the comfort of the future

In today’s world, security is no longer a luxury, but a basic necessity for every home, office, and business. With the rapid development of smart technologies, smart locks have emerged, offering a new concept of protection—one that combines strength, intelligence, and everyday convenience.

The R7Y-TY smart lock represents the new generation of security solutions, as it not only provides protection, but also gives you an integrated control experience, constant monitoring, and an elegant design that blends in with all modern spaces.

Key Features

Multiple unlocking systems

The R7Y-TY is designed to give you maximum freedom and flexibility through smart opening mechanisms to suit every lifestyle:

• Fingerprint recognition with up to 98.9% accuracy for fast response and maximum security.
• Mobile app for remote control and unlocking from anywhere.
• PIN code for easy access without any additional security measures.

Advanced and comprehensive protection

Safety in the R7Y-TY doesn’t stop at the lock:

• Direct notifications to your phone via a dedicated app to keep you informed about everything happening at your door.

• Modern apartments and smart homes

• Retail shops, showrooms, and public facilities

Installation and maintenance tips

To ensure optimal performance of the R7Y-TY lock:

• Choose a precise installation location that matches the door dimensions.
• Ensure correct alignment between the lock body and the frame.
• Regularly update the firmware to protect against any vulnerabilities.
• Charge the battery immediately upon low power alerts to maintain optimal performance.

Why is R7Y-TY a smart investment?

• Enhanced security: Thanks to advanced verification systems and a built-in camera
• Unprecedented ease of use: No keys, no worries, just smart entry
• Complete monitoring: Know who enters and exits anytime, anywhere
• Long lifespan and reliable warranty: Up to 3 years against manufacturing defects

Conclusion

The R7Y-TY is not just a lock… it’s a smart guardian of your lifestyle.
It’s an investment in your peace of mind, in the safety of your family, and in the future of your smart home.
With a touch, a fingerprint, or a tap of your phone… your door becomes more than just a door—
It becomes a smart boundary that protects your private world.

A01 Smart Electronic Lock for Gym Lockers & Cabinets

The A01 Smart Electronic Lock
is an electronic cabinet locking solution designed
for gym lockers, office furniture, storage cabinets,
and compatible game room installations.
It combines convenient access methods with a modern
front panel, making it suitable for environments
where organized cabinet access is important.

The lock supports PIN code entry through a
touch-sensitive numeric keypad, alongside compatible
125kHz RFID cards and wristbands.
These access options allow users to choose
a practical method based on the installation
environment and daily usage requirements.

With its metal front panel and streamlined appearance,
the A01 can complement contemporary locker
and cabinet designs.
Proper installation depends on the cabinet structure,
available mounting space, and compatibility
with the selected access credentials.


PIN Code Access

Enter an authorized PIN code using the
integrated touch keypad to operate
the electronic locking mechanism.

125kHz RFID Card Access

Supports compatible 125kHz RFID cards
as an alternative electronic
unlocking method.

RFID Wristband Access

Works with compatible RFID wristbands,
providing a convenient option
for gym and fitness center users.

Touch-Sensitive Keypad

Features a numeric touch interface
for convenient PIN code entry
without a conventional key.

Metal Front Panel

A modern metal front panel
provides a clean appearance
for cabinet and locker installations.

Versatile Cabinet Applications

Suitable for compatible gym lockers,
office cabinets, game room storage,
and selected furniture units.

Recommended Applications

  • Gym and fitness center lockers.
  • Employee lockers and personal storage cabinets.
  • Office furniture and compatible storage units.
  • Game room cabinets and activity area storage.
  • Commercial furniture projects requiring electronic cabinet locking.

The A01 Smart Electronic Lock is intended
for suitable cabinet applications rather than
being assumed compatible with every door type.
Cabinet dimensions and mounting requirements
should be checked before installation.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Product Name A01 Smart Electronic Lock
Model A01
Product Type Electronic Cabinet and Locker Lock
PIN Code Unlocking Supported through the touch keypad

RFID Wristband Access Compatible 125kHz RFID wristbands

Unlocking Methods & Access Control

The A01 Smart Electronic Lock combines multiple
electronic access methods in one cabinet lock.
Authorized users can enter a PIN code
using the touch-sensitive keypad or present
a compatible 125kHz RFID credential.

RFID wristbands can be particularly convenient
for fitness center environments, where users
may prefer wearing their access credential
rather than carrying a separate card.
For office furniture, PIN code or RFID access
can be selected according to the intended
storage management requirements.

Compatibility should be confirmed for all
RFID cards and wristbands before deployment.
Sharing the same operating frequency does not
automatically guarantee compatibility
with every card or credential type.

Design & Installation Requirements

The A01 features a metal front panel with
a touch-sensitive numeric keypad
and an RFID credential reading area.
This arrangement allows the supported
unlocking methods to be accessed
through a compact user-facing interface.

Before installing the lock, verify the cabinet
door thickness, available internal clearance,
lock dimensions, and mounting arrangement.
These factors affect whether the lock
can be installed securely and operated
as intended.

Power requirements, mounting accessories,
emergency access procedures, and package
contents should be checked against the
exact supplier documentation before
the final installation.

Order the A01 Smart Electronic Lock from Aura

The A01 Smart Electronic Lock offers
electronic locking for compatible
gym lockers, office furniture,
and cabinet applications.
With PIN code entry and support
for compatible RFID cards and wristbands,
it provides flexible access options
for different users and environments.

Contact the Aura team to discuss
your cabinet dimensions,
installation requirements,
and preferred unlocking method.
Our team can help you review
compatibility before selecting
the appropriate locking solution.


Installation & Compatibility Notes:

Confirm the exact lock dimensions,
power requirements, mounting hardware,
and included accessories before installation.

RFID cards and wristbands must be compatible
with the A01 lock. Fingerprint unlocking,
Wi-Fi connectivity, Bluetooth control,
or mobile application access should not
be assumed unless explicitly confirmed
in the model specifications.

3D Face Recognition
Palm Vein Access
1080p Built-In Camera
4-Inch Display
Wi-Fi & Bluetooth

EZVIZ PLUS Smart Lock Y3000FVP
with Face and Palm Vein Recognition

Discover advanced entrance security
with the EZVIZ PLUS Smart Lock,
model Y3000FVP PLUS.
This premium door lock combines
eight unlocking methods with
built-in video monitoring,
intelligent security alerts,
and convenient app control.

The EZVIZ Y3000FVP PLUS Smart Lock
supports advanced 3D face recognition,
touchless palm vein authentication,
fingerprint entry, PIN codes,
mechanical keys, Bluetooth unlocking,
temporary access codes,
and supported remote unlocking.

A built-in 1080p camera and
4-inch indoor display let
household members view visitors
without opening the door.
Two-way video calling and
smartphone connectivity make
daily entrance management easier.

Finished in Metallic Black,
this smart lock with camera
is designed for compatible
residential entrance doors.


3D Face Recognition
Advanced depth-sensing technology
provides fast, touchless entry
for registered users.
Palm Vein Recognition
Biometric authentication recognizes
registered palm vein patterns
without touching the lock.
Built-In Camera
The 1080p camera enables
visual monitoring of visitors
at the entrance.
Two-Way Video Calling
Communicate with visitors
through supported video
calling functions.
EZVIZ App Control
Manage access functions,
notifications, and supported
remote control features.
Smart Security Alerts
Get relevant alerts for
suspicious activity, tampering,
and low battery.

Key Features of the EZVIZ PLUS Smart Lock

The Y3000FVP PLUS combines
biometric identification,
smart video technology,
and connected access management
in one modern door security device.

  • 3D facial recognition with depth sensing.
  • Touchless palm vein authentication.
  • Fingerprint recognition for registered users.
  • Eight supported unlocking methods.
  • Built-in 1080p security camera.
  • 4-inch indoor IPS color display.
  • Infrared night vision up to 2 meters.
  • Two-way video calls with voice changer support.
  • 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity.
  • Remote management through the EZVIZ App.
  • Temporary access codes for visitors.
  • Human presence and wandering detection.
  • Anti-peeping passcode protection.
  • Anti-tamper and incorrect-entry protection.
  • Privacy mode and activity notifications.
  • 5000mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

Eight Smart Door Unlocking Methods

The device provides flexible
entry options for family members,
approved visitors, and other
authorized users.

Method Details
3D Face Recognition Unlock using a registered
facial profile.
Palm Vein Touchless authentication
using registered palm veins.
Fingerprint Biometric access through
a registered fingerprint.
Passcode Enter an authorized
PIN through the keypad.
Mechanical Key Alternative physical
unlocking method.
Bluetooth Key Bluetooth unlocking
through the EZVIZ App.
Temporary Codes Grant time-limited access
to trusted visitors.
Remote Unlocking Supported app-based
access after configuration.

Smart Lock with Camera and Visitor Monitoring

The built-in camera allows
residents to view the area
in front of the entrance.
It provides a 150-degree
diagonal field of view
for better doorstep awareness.

The 4-inch indoor display
offers a convenient way
to check visitors without
using a mobile phone.

Infrared night vision reaches
up to 2 meters, while
two-way communication enables
supported video conversations
with visitors.

The device also supports
human presence detection
and wandering alerts,
helping users stay informed
about relevant doorstep activity.

Local Storage and Video Recording

The lock supports eMMC local
storage for compatible
video recording functions.

An 8GB internal storage
configuration is listed
for certain regional versions.
The supplied version should
be confirmed before purchase.

Supported EZVIZ CloudPlay
storage services may also
be available depending
on subscription and region.

Face Recognition and Palm Vein Technology

The face recognition system
uses 3D depth sensing to
authenticate registered users
without physical contact.

EZVIZ laboratory tests indicate
facial recognition in one second
or less under suitable conditions,
at a standing distance of
less than one meter.

Palm vein authentication
operates with the palm
positioned approximately
15 to 25 cm from the sensor,
according to manufacturer tests.

Biometric information is
processed and stored locally,
supporting the device’s
privacy-oriented design.

EZVIZ App and Remote Access Management

Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity
support smart access functions
through the EZVIZ App.

  • Manage registered users and access methods.
  • Create supported temporary access codes.
  • Receive important security notifications.
  • Check lock status and activity history.
  • Use supported remote unlocking functions.
  • Communicate with visitors through video calling.
  • Review battery notifications.
  • Configure available privacy settings.

Advanced Security and Smart Alerts

The EZVIZ PLUS Smart Lock
includes protective functions
designed to help reduce
unauthorized access attempts.

  • Anti-Tamper Alarm:
    Warns when forceful removal
    or tampering is detected.
  • Anti-Peeping PIN:
    Allows additional digits
    around the actual passcode.
  • Wandering Detection:
    Provides alerts for certain
    lingering activity at the door.
  • Incorrect Attempt Protection:
    Temporarily disables electronic
    unlocking after repeated
    incorrect entries.
  • Privacy Mode:
    Provides supported access
    restrictions and settings.
  • Low-Battery Warning:
    Alerts users when charging
    is required.

The manufacturer specifies
a three-minute electronic
unlocking lockout after
five consecutive incorrect
unlocking attempts.

Automatic Locking and Door Safety

Supported automatic locking
behavior depends on the
supplied mechanical lock body
and installation configuration.

The 6068 configuration is
described by EZVIZ as using
an automatic mechanical
detection lock body.

Verify the automatic locking
function of the supplied unit
before installation and use.

Rechargeable Battery and Emergency Power

The device uses a
5000mAh rechargeable
lithium battery
to power smart access
and visitor monitoring features.

Battery performance depends
on usage frequency, camera
activity, wireless connectivity,
and operating conditions.

EZVIZ advertises up to
four months of battery life
under specified test conditions.
Actual performance may vary.

A USB Type-C interface
allows temporary external
power when the battery
needs charging.

Installation and Door Compatibility

multiple unlocking methods,

in a modern door lock designed

The device combines convenient
biometric entry with intelligent
access management for households
looking to upgrade traditional
mechanical door security.

  • Fingerprint reader built
    into the door handle.
  • Local storage for up
    to 50 fingerprints.
  • Permanent and temporary
    access passcodes.

    for authorized users.

The access system offers multiple

allowing household members
and approved visitors to use
the method that best suits
their needs.

fingerprint using the
handle-mounted sensor.
PIN Code Enter a personal access
code through the keypad.
Proximity Card Use a registered
compatible access card.

unlocking method.

entry through the app.

entry credentials

Smart Security Alerts and Protection

security notifications

  • Protection against repeated

This smart lock fingerprint lock

when the installed batteries

With one compact hub, you can connect lights, switches, curtain motors, sensors and more, and control them from Tuya / Smart Life, Google Home and Apple HomeKit.
zemismart-m1-matter-zigbee-thread-hub.description:
Zemismart Matter Zigbee Thread Smart Home Hub – Multi-Protocol Matter Bridge

The Zemismart M1 Matter Hub is a multi-protocol smart home bridge designed
to bring your Tuya ZigBee and Thread devices into a unified
Matter-certified ecosystem. With one compact hub, you can connect lights,
switches, curtain motors, sensors and more, and control them from
Tuya / Smart Life, Google Home and Apple HomeKit.

Key Features

  • Support Multi-Protocol: works with Tuya ZigBee standard devices and Thread devices, and exposes them to a Matter system (Matter border router required).
  • Multi-platform usage: allows Tuya ZigBee devices to be used on third-party platforms like Google Home and HomeKit via Matter.
  • APP Remote Control: control all your connected devices anytime, anywhere with Tuya App / Smart Life App / Google Home / HomeKit.
  • Voice Control: once Thread/ZigBee devices are added to the hub, you can control them via Siri and Google Assistant.
  • Multi sub-device control: connect various sub-devices (lights, switches, roller motors, curtain tracks, sensors, etc.) and create powerful smart scenes.
  • Wired network connection: built-in RJ45 Ethernet port for a more stable and efficient connection to the internet.
  • High-quality craftsmanship: flame-retardant plastic housing and clean internal layout ensure long-term reliable operation.

What Can the M1 Hub Control?

  • ZigBee devices: ceiling lamps, downlights, EU/US wall switches, roller motors, curtain drivers, PIR motion sensors, door/window sensors, temperature & humidity sensors and more.
  • Thread devices: Thread curtain motors, Thread roller shade motors, Thread switches and other Thread-based accessories.
  • Through Matter, these devices can be visible and controllable in both Google Home and Apple Home apps.

Technical Overview

Product Name Zemismart Matter Zigbee Thread Smart Home Hub (M1)
Protocols Tuya ZigBee Standard, Thread, Matter (via Matter border router)
Smart Platforms Tuya App, Smart Life App, Google Home, Apple HomeKit
Voice Assistants Siri, Google Assistant (after linking through Matter)
Internet Connection RJ45 Ethernet (internet cable required)
Housing Material Flame-retardant plastic
Main Function Matter bridge for ZigBee/Thread sub-devices, scene automation and multi-platform control

aqara-smart-door-lock-d200i.shortDescription: Aqara Smart Lock D200i is a 3D Face Recognition Smart Lock offering secure, keyless entry. aqara-smart-door-lock-d200i.description:
Aqara Smart Lock D200i –
Secure 3D Face Recognition Door Lock

The Aqara Smart Lock D200i
is a fully automatic smart door lock
designed to make everyday access
more convenient and secure.
It combines advanced
3D structured-light face recognition
with multiple unlocking methods,
smart connectivity, and practical
door security functions.

This advanced
3D Face Recognition Smart Lock
allows authorized users
to unlock the door
without searching for keys
or entering a password
every time they arrive home.

The lock also supports
Apple Home Key, PIN codes,
compatible NFC access,
Bluetooth-based functions,
and a mechanical emergency key.
These alternatives provide
flexibility for different users
and everyday situations.

With the Aqara Home application
and compatible connected-home equipment,
users can access supported
lock management features,
review notifications,
and integrate door events
into selected smart home scenes.

3D Face Recognition
Apple Home Key
PIN Code
NFC
Bluetooth 5.1
Zigbee
Emergency Key

Secure 3D Face Recognition Unlocking

The lock uses advanced
3D structured-light technology
to recognize registered faces.

This offers a convenient,
contactless way to enter
the home without using
a physical key or touching
the numeric keypad.

Aqara 3D Face Recognition
technology analyzes
three-dimensional facial
information rather than
relying only on a flat image.

Recognition performance
depends on proper enrollment,
camera visibility,
user positioning,
and environmental conditions.

Apple Home Key for Compatible Devices

Apple Home Key provides
another convenient way
to unlock the door
using a compatible
iPhone or Apple Watch.

Once properly configured,
users can present
their supported device
near the lock’s NFC area
to authenticate.

Availability depends on
compatible Apple hardware,
software, region,
and setup requirements.

PIN Codes and Compatible NFC Access

The electronic keypad
supports password-based
door access for
authorized users.

Supported password options
can include normal,
temporary, and scheduled
access configurations.

Compatible NFC methods
offer additional ways
to unlock the door
according to device
and credential compatibility.

Mechanical Key and Emergency Power

The lock includes
a mechanical lock cylinder
and emergency keys
for alternative access
when necessary.

An external USB-C port
allows temporary emergency
power to be supplied
when the normal battery
cannot operate the lock.

Emergency operation should
follow the manufacturer’s
instructions and
approved power requirements.

Key Features of the Aqara D200i Smart Lock

  • 3D Face Recognition:
    Contactless unlocking
    with registered facial data.
  • Apple Home Key:
    Unlock through supported
    Apple devices and configurations.
  • Password Access:
    PIN entry with compatible
    access management functions.
  • NFC Support:
    Additional access methods
    using supported credentials.
  • Emergency Mechanical Keys:
    A backup unlocking option
    when electronic access
    is unavailable.
  • Automatic Locking:
    Motorized locking functions
    after proper door closure.
  • Door Status and Alerts:
    Supported notifications
    for abnormal lock conditions
    and unsuccessful authentication.
  • Smart Home Integration:
    Connectivity through Wi-Fi,
    Bluetooth, Zigbee,
    and supported Apple Home
    or Aqara Home functions.

Advanced Facial Recognition and Daily Convenience

The facial recognition system
helps authorized household members
enter without carrying
a physical key.

According to Aqara’s
product documentation,
the lock can store
up to 50 registered faces.

Users should follow
the enrollment instructions
and position themselves
at an appropriate distance
from the face recognition module.

For reliable authentication,
the module should be kept clean
and free from obstructions.

Face recognition settings,
including supported activation
or standby behavior,
can be adjusted through
the relevant product controls.

User Management and Access Permissions

The lock offers multiple
authentication methods,
making it suitable
for households where
family members have
different access preferences.

Authorized users can
configure supported
unlocking methods
through the Aqara Home app
and the lock’s local
management functions.

Certain password functions
may help manage access
for visitors or individuals
who need entry
during selected periods.

Actual management features
depend on account permissions,
device configuration,
and available software.

Smart Home Scenes and Automation

Compatible integrations
allow selected lock events
to participate in
smart home automation.

For example, a supported
door unlocking event
may activate a hallway light,
start a welcome scene,
or trigger another
connected-home action.

These functions require
compatible accessories,
supported automation services,
and any additional hub
required by the chosen platform.

The Aqara Smart Lock D200i
is designed to work
within connected-home setups,
but not every automation
is available on every ecosystem.

Door Security and Tamper Alerts

The lock provides
security-related functions
including abnormal
door status reporting
and warnings for
certain unsuccessful
authentication attempts.

Its electronic lock body
can monitor supported
bolt and door conditions
to help identify
incomplete closure
or locking problems.

These functions complement
proper physical door security
but do not replace
correct mechanical
installation and alignment.

Fully Automatic Locking Mechanism

The motorized lock body
is designed to support
automatic locking
after the door closes
under the appropriate
operating conditions.

This can reduce
the need to manually
turn a key every time
the door is closed.

Accurate installation
is essential to ensure
that the lock body,
strike plate,
and door frame
work together correctly.

A professional installer
should verify mechanical
operation before
enabling smart functions.

Rechargeable Lithium Batteries and USB-C Backup

The device uses
replaceable rechargeable
lithium-ion batteries.
The standard package
contains two lithium batteries.

Battery operating time
depends on unlocking frequency,
wireless connectivity,
environmental conditions,
and the features enabled.

When emergency power
is required,
the USB-C port supports
a 5V / 2A external supply
as specified by Aqara.

Always recharge
and handle the batteries
according to the
manufacturer’s instructions.

Wireless Connectivity and Smart Home Support

The lock supports
2.4GHz Wi-Fi,
Bluetooth 5.1,
Zigbee, and NFC
wireless technologies.

These technologies
enable supported
lock-management,
access-control,
and connected-home functions.

Some features may work
through local connectivity,
while remote access
or third-party automations
may require a suitable hub,
network connection,
or account setup.

Protection Ratings and Installation Environment

The lock has an
IP52 protection rating,
while the face recognition
module is rated
IP64.

These ratings describe
specific resistance
to dust and water exposure,
not complete waterproofing
of the entire lock.

For best reliability,
install the device
in an appropriately protected
doorway rather than
a location exposed
to continuous direct rain,
water jets, or severe weather.

Professional Installation and Door Compatibility

Before purchasing,
confirm the door thickness,
opening direction,
existing lock body,
and available mounting space.

The product includes
an external panel,
internal panel,
dedicated lock body,
and additional mechanical
installation components.

These components must
be fitted and aligned
to ensure correct
door operation.

Professional installation
is recommended,
using the supplied
installation diagram
and the current
manufacturer instructions.

Suitable Uses for Residential Doors

This 3D Face Recognition
Smart Lock is suitable
for residential entrances
where compatible door
construction and
installation conditions
are available.

Families can benefit
from different access methods,
including facial recognition,
Apple Home Key,
passwords,
and mechanical backup keys.

The lock may also
be included in broader
smart home projects
that combine door security,
lighting automation,
and access management.

Why Choose the Aqara Smart Lock D200i?

The lock combines
advanced facial recognition,

Its support for Apple Home Key,
